title: Senior Full-Stack Developer to Build/Rebuild Our Custom Website & Ecommerce Platform
description:
We're Accelerator, a sports supplement company focused on enhancing athlete performance. We need an experienced developer to build a custom web application / ecommerce platform for us — or rebuild and migrate the one we already have. Off-the-shelf themes won't cut it; we have specific business logic (subscriptions, athlete accounts, stack/bundle builders), integrations, and performance requirements.

The work is a custom build, not a template drop-in. Depending on your background this could be a fresh build, a migration off our current platform, or extending an existing app with new features and API integrations.

What the project involves:

- Custom back end (Laravel / PHP / MySQL) with a modern JavaScript front end
- Ecommerce or portal functionality: supplement catalog, athlete accounts, checkout or B2B ordering for teams, gyms, and retailers
- Third-party API integrations (payments, subscription billing, ERP/CRM, fulfillment and internal tools)
- Clean, fast, responsive front end — performance matters to us as much as it does to our athletes
- If a migration: moving data off the old platform with zero data loss

Please share two or three custom builds you've shipped that are close to this — ideally with a live URL — and a one-line note on what you built and the stack. Point us to the project that best matches our problem, not just your longest list.

We'll scope timeline and budget on a quick call once we've seen requirements.
ai_reason: Low budget for custom full-stack development project

Do you have experience with similar projects (WooCommerce + product variations + visual improvements)? Would this be something you’re interested in?

Best regards

title: Claude expert to build a working copy of native.no
description:
I'm hiring one person to build an MVP that replicates native.no. Go study that site before applying, it's the exact spec: a business owner enters their website URL, the product analyzes their business, generates a month of social posts (text + images) in their brand voice, and publishes approved posts to social channels after approval.

To be clear: this is a 1:1 functional copy. The functionality and features should be exactly what native.no offers, no more, no less. Organic social content only, no paid ads features.

MVP SCOPE (native.no's core loop)
- Landing page with signup, in our own brand and design
- URL in, brand and business analysis out
- Generation pipeline producing 30+ posts with images
- Simple dashboard: review, edit in plain language, approve
- Publishing to Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn via an aggregator API (Ayrshare or similar)
- Basic auth and billing (Stripe)

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

An expert with Claude or similar AI tools. You don't need a traditional dev background, you need to ship working products with Claude Code or comparable tooling and know the Claude API inside out. Stack is your call, I care about output.

The critical skill: taste in LLM outputs. Anyone can wire up an API call that produces content. I need someone who can look at 50 generated posts, see why they feel generic, and fix it through better prompting, examples and feedback loops. The product lives or dies on whether a business owner is proud to publish these posts. If your instinct is "the API returned text, ship it," this isn't for you.

STRUCTURE

Fixed price for the MVP. Ongoing work after that if it's good.

TO APPLY

1. Show me something that you have built.
2. Tell me one thing native.no does that will be hardest to replicate well, and why.
3. Offer your price and how long you'll need.

No generic cover letters.

title: Experienced WordPress Developer Needed for White-Label Hotel Booking Platform
description:
About Viajar Libremente

Viajar Libremente is a travel company focused on meaningful travel experiences throughout Latin America. Our mission is to connect travelers with authentic destinations while supporting local communities through responsible tourism.

We’re expanding our website by integrating a white-label hotel booking platform through one of our travel technology partners. This will allow travelers to search for and reserve hotels directly through the Viajar Libremente website while maintaining our own brand and customer experience.

We’re looking for a dependable WordPress developer who enjoys building long-term relationships and wants to help us create something meaningful.

⸻

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced WordPress developer to integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.

Our website is already live, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable working within an existing production environment while preserving the site’s current functionality, branding, and performance.

This is intended to be the beginning of a long-term working relationship as Viajar Libremente continues to expand its travel platform.

⸻

Responsibilities

* Integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.
* Collaborate with our internal team and our travel technology partner throughout the implementation process.
* Participate in virtual meetings as needed.
* Test the integration before launch.
* Help ensure the booking experience is responsive, user-friendly, and reliable.
* Recommend improvements that enhance the user experience while maintaining our existing brand identity.
* Document any custom development for future maintenance.

⸻

Required Qualifications

* Strong WordPress development experience.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs or white-label platforms.
* Comfortable working on an existing live WordPress website.
* Comfortable attending virtual meetings with internal team members and external development partners.
* Conversational English and Spanish.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Open to collaboration, constructive feedback, and an iterative development process.

Preferred Qualifications

* Based in Colombia (preferred, not required), as occasional in-person collaboration may become beneficial as the project grows.
* Experience with travel websites, booking engines, reservation systems, or WooCommerce.
* UI/UX experience.
* Website performance optimization experience.

⸻

Budget

Budget: Approximately $15 USD/hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and proposed approach.

We recognize that every developer brings different experience and strengths. If you believe you’re an excellent fit for this project, we’d love to hear why.

Expected Start: We anticipate beginning Phase 1 (Discovery & Planning) in August 2026. Phase 2 (Development & Integration) will begin after the implementation plan has been reviewed and approved.

Project Phases

Phase 1 – Discovery & Planning

Before development begins, we’d like to work together to:

* Review the API documentation.
* Review the existing website.
* Meet virtually with our team.
* Meet with our technology partner if needed.
* Develop an implementation plan.
* Identify technical considerations and potential challenges.
* Recommend a project timeline and milestone schedule.

This phase allows both parties to determine whether we’re a good long-term fit before moving into implementation.

⸻

Phase 2 – Development & Integration

Following approval of the implementation plan, the selected developer will:

* Complete the hotel booking integration.
* Assist with testing and quality assurance.
* Resolve bugs and technical issues.
* Prepare the website for launch.
* Provide documentation for future maintenance.

⸻

To Apply

Please include:

* A brief introduction about yourself.
* Your WordPress experience.
* Examples of similar API integrations or booking platform projects.
* Links to your portfolio.
* Why you believe you’re a good fit for this project.
* Your estimated timeline after reviewing the project requirements.

To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the project description, please begin your proposal with the words: “Viajar Libremente.”

⸻

About Our Culture

We’re looking for more than someone who can write code.

We value honesty, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re building Viajar Libremente for the long term and want to work with people who take pride in producing quality work while helping bring meaningful ideas to life.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer to make a series of content, image, layout, functionality, and rebranding updates to our existing website.

The website is already live, and we have a detailed edits document outlining the required changes. The work includes updating website content, replacing selected images, improving formatting, editing service and team sections, fixing links and forms, and rebranding one existing page.

Scope of Work Includes:

1) Update website text, statistics, service details, and team information
2) Replace selected images across the homepage, services, partners, and profile pages
3) Remove outdated services, team members, titles, and unnecessary hyperlinks
4) Adjust page layouts and formatting for a cleaner desktop and mobile view
5) Update forms, buttons, and links, including the appointment button flow
6) Add client/partner logos provided by our team
7) Rebrand the Corporate Wellness Department page, including page name, wording, visuals, layout, and menu labels

Requirements:

1) Strong experience with WordPress website editing and development
2) Ability to work with custom code when needed, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic PHP
3) Good eye for clean, professional design
4) Ability to follow a detailed edits document carefully
5) Experience with responsive desktop and mobile updates
6) Ability to edit links, forms, buttons, images, and page content
7) Clear communication and regular progress updates

Deliverables:

1) All website edits completed according to the provided document
2) Rebranded Corporate Wellness Department page
3) Desktop and mobile review of all updated pages
4) Forms, links, and appointment button tested
5) Final quality check before completion

We will provide the full edits document, replacement images, logos, new branding direction, and any additional content needed.

title: Experienced WordPress Developer Needed for White-Label Hotel Booking Platform
description:
About Viajar Libremente

Viajar Libremente is a travel company focused on meaningful travel experiences throughout Latin America. Our mission is to connect travelers with authentic destinations while supporting local communities through responsible tourism.

We’re expanding our website by integrating a white-label hotel booking platform through one of our travel technology partners. This will allow travelers to search for and reserve hotels directly through the Viajar Libremente website while maintaining our own brand and customer experience.

We’re looking for a dependable WordPress developer who enjoys building long-term relationships and wants to help us create something meaningful.

⸻

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced WordPress developer to integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.

Our website is already live, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable working within an existing production environment while preserving the site’s current functionality, branding, and performance.

This is intended to be the beginning of a long-term working relationship as Viajar Libremente continues to expand its travel platform.

⸻

Responsibilities

* Integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.
* Collaborate with our internal team and our travel technology partner throughout the implementation process.
* Participate in virtual meetings as needed.
* Test the integration before launch.
* Help ensure the booking experience is responsive, user-friendly, and reliable.
* Recommend improvements that enhance the user experience while maintaining our existing brand identity.
* Document any custom development for future maintenance.

⸻

Required Qualifications

* Strong WordPress development experience.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs or white-label platforms.
* Comfortable working on an existing live WordPress website.
* Comfortable attending virtual meetings with internal team members and external development partners.
* Conversational English and Spanish.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Open to collaboration, constructive feedback, and an iterative development process.

Preferred Qualifications

* Based in Colombia (preferred, not required), as occasional in-person collaboration may become beneficial as the project grows.
* Experience with travel websites, booking engines, reservation systems, or WooCommerce.
* UI/UX experience.
* Website performance optimization experience.

⸻

Budget

Budget: Approximately $15 USD/hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and proposed approach.

We recognize that every developer brings different experience and strengths. If you believe you’re an excellent fit for this project, we’d love to hear why.

Expected Start: We anticipate beginning Phase 1 (Discovery & Planning) in August 2026. Phase 2 (Development & Integration) will begin after the implementation plan has been reviewed and approved.

Project Phases

Phase 1 – Discovery & Planning

Before development begins, we’d like to work together to:

* Review the API documentation.
* Review the existing website.
* Meet virtually with our team.
* Meet with our technology partner if needed.
* Develop an implementation plan.
* Identify technical considerations and potential challenges.
* Recommend a project timeline and milestone schedule.

This phase allows both parties to determine whether we’re a good long-term fit before moving into implementation.

⸻

Phase 2 – Development & Integration

Following approval of the implementation plan, the selected developer will:

* Complete the hotel booking integration.
* Assist with testing and quality assurance.
* Resolve bugs and technical issues.
* Prepare the website for launch.
* Provide documentation for future maintenance.

⸻

To Apply

Please include:

* A brief introduction about yourself.
* Your WordPress experience.
* Examples of similar API integrations or booking platform projects.
* Links to your portfolio.
* Why you believe you’re a good fit for this project.
* Your estimated timeline after reviewing the project requirements.

To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the project description, please begin your proposal with the words: “Viajar Libremente.”

⸻

About Our Culture

We’re looking for more than someone who can write code.

We value honesty, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re building Viajar Libremente for the long term and want to work with people who take pride in producing quality work while helping bring meaningful ideas to life.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: WordPress Developer Needed to Build Custom Post Type Portfolio
description:
I'm a photographer and right now all my work just lives in a regular blog-style gallery, which makes it impossible to organize by shoot type. I want a proper "Projects" custom post type set up — separate from regular blog posts — with its own fields for things like client name, shoot category (wedding, portrait, event), and a featured image gallery per entry. 

Once that's set up, I need an archive page that displays these as a filterable grid by category, plus individual project pages that show the full photo set. 

I'm not picky about which method you use to build the custom post type (plugin like CPT UI, or hand-coded in functions. php, whatever you're most comfortable with and think will hold up long-term) but I do care that it's set up cleanly since I plan to add dozens more entries over time and don't want this breaking as the site grows. 

Happy to share reference sites if that helps explain the layout I'm after.

title: Wordpress Woocommerce Speed Optimization
description:
**Job Title:** WordPress Performance & MySQL Database Optimization Specialist

We're looking for an experienced WordPress performance expert to optimize our website's MySQL database and significantly improve page load speed and overall user experience.

### Project Overview

Our website is built on WordPress with WooCommerce and serves a large product catalog. We're looking for someone who can identify performance bottlenecks, optimize the database, and improve frontend and backend performance without breaking existing functionality.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze and optimize the MySQL database for maximum performance.
* Identify and remove unnecessary database overhead (revisions, transients, orphaned data, etc.).
* Optimize slow SQL queries and improve query execution times.
* Review and optimize WordPress database indexes where appropriate.
* Audit plugins and identify database-intensive operations.
* Improve WordPress backend responsiveness.
* Optimize page load times and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement caching strategies (database, object cache, page cache) when appropriate.
* Optimize WooCommerce performance for large product catalogs.
* Review server configuration and recommend improvements if needed.
* Ensure all optimizations are safe, documented, and reversible.

### Required Skills

* Advanced MySQL optimization.
* Strong WordPress and WooCommerce experience.
* Experience profiling slow queries using tools such as Query Monitor, MySQL EXPLAIN, or similar.
* Knowledge of Redis, Memcached, or object caching.
* Familiarity with LiteSpeed, Nginx, or Apache optimization.
* Experience with PHP performance optimization.
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance best practices.

### Nice to Have

* Experience with large WooCommerce stores.
* Experience optimizing Elementor-based websites.
* Knowledge of Cloudflare/CDNs.
* Linux server administration experience.

### Deliverables

* Full performance audit with identified bottlenecks.
* Optimized MySQL database.
* Improved WordPress backend speed.
* Faster frontend loading times.
* Before-and-after performance metrics (PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar).
* Documentation of all changes made.

### What We're Looking For

Please include:

* Examples of WordPress websites you've optimized.
* Before-and-after performance improvements you've achieved.
* Your approach to database optimization.
* Estimated timeline.
* Your hourly rate or fixed project price.

We're looking for someone who focuses on long-term performance improvements—not just installing caching plugins. The ideal candidate understands how WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL, PHP, and the hosting environment work together to deliver a fast, reliable user experience.

Viajar Libremente is a travel company focused on meaningful travel experiences throughout Latin America. Our mission is to connect travelers with authentic destinations while supporting local communities through responsible tourism.

We’re expanding our website by integrating a white-label hotel booking platform through one of our travel technology partners. This will allow travelers to search for and reserve hotels directly through the Viajar Libremente website while maintaining our own brand and customer experience.

We’re looking for a dependable WordPress developer who enjoys building long-term relationships and wants to help us create something meaningful.

⸻

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced WordPress developer to integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.

Our website is already live, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable working within an existing production environment while preserving the site’s current functionality, branding, and performance.

This is intended to be the beginning of a long-term working relationship as Viajar Libremente continues to expand its travel platform.

⸻

Responsibilities

* Integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.
* Collaborate with our internal team and our travel technology partner throughout the implementation process.
* Participate in virtual meetings as needed.
* Test the integration before launch.
* Help ensure the booking experience is responsive, user-friendly, and reliable.
* Recommend improvements that enhance the user experience while maintaining our existing brand identity.
* Document any custom development for future maintenance.

⸻

Required Qualifications

* Strong WordPress development experience.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs or white-label platforms.
* Comfortable working on an existing live WordPress website.
* Comfortable attending virtual meetings with internal team members and external development partners.
* Conversational English and Spanish.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Open to collaboration, constructive feedback, and an iterative development process.

Preferred Qualifications

* Based in Colombia (preferred, not required), as occasional in-person collaboration may become beneficial as the project grows.
* Experience with travel websites, booking engines, reservation systems, or WooCommerce.
* UI/UX experience.
* Website performance optimization experience.

⸻

Budget

Budget: Approximately $15 USD/hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and proposed approach.

We recognize that every developer brings different experience and strengths. If you believe you’re an excellent fit for this project, we’d love to hear why.

Expected Start: We anticipate beginning Phase 1 (Discovery & Planning) in August 2026. Phase 2 (Development & Integration) will begin after the implementation plan has been reviewed and approved.

Project Phases

Phase 1 – Discovery & Planning

Before development begins, we’d like to work together to:

* Review the API documentation.
* Review the existing website.
* Meet virtually with our team.
* Meet with our technology partner if needed.
* Develop an implementation plan.
* Identify technical considerations and potential challenges.
* Recommend a project timeline and milestone schedule.

This phase allows both parties to determine whether we’re a good long-term fit before moving into implementation.

⸻

Phase 2 – Development & Integration

Following approval of the implementation plan, the selected developer will:

* Complete the hotel booking integration.
* Assist with testing and quality assurance.
* Resolve bugs and technical issues.
* Prepare the website for launch.
* Provide documentation for future maintenance.

⸻

To Apply

Please include:

* A brief introduction about yourself.
* Your WordPress experience.
* Examples of similar API integrations or booking platform projects.
* Links to your portfolio.
* Why you believe you’re a good fit for this project.
* Your estimated timeline after reviewing the project requirements.

To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the project description, please begin your proposal with the words: “Viajar Libremente.”

⸻

About Our Culture

We’re looking for more than someone who can write code.

We value honesty, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re building Viajar Libremente for the long term and want to work with people who take pride in producing quality work while helping bring meaningful ideas to life.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Dev & Design Elements for Custom Content Management System
description:
We are currently rebuilding our proprietary Content Management System, CoreContent 2.0, potentially using the latest Laravel framework with FilamentPHP as the administrative foundation.  (we are still open to other cms packages for laravel)

The core architecture and backend development are already underway with our internal development team and a senior technical consultant. We are now looking for an experienced UI/UX Product Designer to help define the visual identity, usability, and overall user experience of the platform.

This is much more than designing a website. We are building a modern, AI-powered content management platform that will be used daily by marketing professionals, content editors, sales teams, and business owners to manage websites, product catalogs, service offerings, digital marketing campaigns, and customer lead generation.

About Us

We are an established industrial manufacturing marketing company specializing in custom web development, SEO, digital marketing, and proprietary software solutions for manufacturers, distributors, and B2B organizations.

Over the past several years, our proprietary CMS has powered hundreds of industrial websites focused on content management, product catalogs, lead generation, and search engine optimization.

CoreContent 2.0 represents the next evolution of our platform, emphasizing modern usability, AI-assisted workflows, stronger security, improved performance, and a best-in-class editing experience.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a designer who thinks like a product designer—not just a visual designer.

The ideal candidate has experience designing:

SaaS applications
Content Management Systems (CMS)
Administrative dashboards
Marketing platforms
Business applications
Design systems and reusable UI libraries

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who enjoys improving workflows and simplifying complex software into intuitive user experiences.

Primary Responsibilities
Dashboard Design

Design a modern administrative dashboard that serves as the primary workspace for users.

This includes:

Dashboard layout
Navigation
Analytics widgets
Search experience
Notifications
User profile experience
Mobile responsiveness
Overall information architecture
CMS User Experience

Design intuitive interfaces for managing:

Website pages
Product catalogs
Service pages
Media library
SEO tools
Forms
User administration
AI-powered content tools
Publishing workflows

The goal is to create an editing experience that is powerful while remaining approachable for non-technical users.

Front-End Website Concept

Develop a sample front-end website concept that demonstrates the design direction for websites built on CoreContent 2.0.

The concept should include:

Homepage
Interior page
Product page
Service page
Mobile layouts
Responsive behavior
Modern UI components

Rather than producing a single custom design, the objective is to establish a flexible visual framework that can be adapted across future client projects.

Design System

Help establish a reusable design system that will become the foundation for future websites.

This includes defining:

Typography
Color palettes
Icons
Buttons
Forms
Cards
Navigation styles
Grid system
Spacing standards
Reusable interface components
Workflow & Process Improvement

One of the most important objectives of this engagement is improving how design integrates into our overall development process.

We're looking for someone who can collaborate with our team to create a more efficient, scalable workflow from initial concept through development.

Areas of focus include:

Design handoff standards
Component libraries
Figma organization
Design tokens
Reusable templates
Developer-ready specifications
Version control for design assets
AI-assisted design workflows
Opportunities to streamline future website production

Our goal is not simply to redesign our software—we want to improve the entire design process for every future project we build.

Ideal Qualifications
Extensive UI/UX design experience
Strong portfolio of SaaS or CMS applications
Advanced Figma skills
Experience building design systems
Knowledge of responsive web design
Understanding of accessibility best practices
Ability to work closely with developers and product stakeholders
Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred experience includes:

Laravel or Filament-based applications
Administrative dashboard design
AI-assisted design tools
Product strategy
B2B software platforms
Industrial or manufacturing-related applications
Deliverables

The selected designer will work collaboratively with our internal team to produce:

CoreContent 2.0 dashboard design
Complete administrative UI/UX concepts
Front-end website concept
Responsive layouts
Design system
Component library
Style guide
Developer handoff documentation
Recommendations for improving our long-term design workflow

title: Wordpress Woocommerce Speed Optimization
description:
**Job Title:** WordPress Performance & MySQL Database Optimization Specialist

We're looking for an experienced WordPress performance expert to optimize our website's MySQL database and significantly improve page load speed and overall user experience.

### Project Overview

Our website is built on WordPress with WooCommerce and serves a large product catalog. We're looking for someone who can identify performance bottlenecks, optimize the database, and improve frontend and backend performance without breaking existing functionality.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze and optimize the MySQL database for maximum performance.
* Identify and remove unnecessary database overhead (revisions, transients, orphaned data, etc.).
* Optimize slow SQL queries and improve query execution times.
* Review and optimize WordPress database indexes where appropriate.
* Audit plugins and identify database-intensive operations.
* Improve WordPress backend responsiveness.
* Optimize page load times and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement caching strategies (database, object cache, page cache) when appropriate.
* Optimize WooCommerce performance for large product catalogs.
* Review server configuration and recommend improvements if needed.
* Ensure all optimizations are safe, documented, and reversible.

### Required Skills

* Advanced MySQL optimization.
* Strong WordPress and WooCommerce experience.
* Experience profiling slow queries using tools such as Query Monitor, MySQL EXPLAIN, or similar.
* Knowledge of Redis, Memcached, or object caching.
* Familiarity with LiteSpeed, Nginx, or Apache optimization.
* Experience with PHP performance optimization.
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance best practices.

### Nice to Have

* Experience with large WooCommerce stores.
* Experience optimizing Elementor-based websites.
* Knowledge of Cloudflare/CDNs.
* Linux server administration experience.

### Deliverables

* Full performance audit with identified bottlenecks.
* Optimized MySQL database.
* Improved WordPress backend speed.
* Faster frontend loading times.
* Before-and-after performance metrics (PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar).
* Documentation of all changes made.

### What We're Looking For

Please include:

* Examples of WordPress websites you've optimized.
* Before-and-after performance improvements you've achieved.
* Your approach to database optimization.
* Estimated timeline.
* Your hourly rate or fixed project price.

We're looking for someone who focuses on long-term performance improvements—not just installing caching plugins. The ideal candidate understands how WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL, PHP, and the hosting environment work together to deliver a fast, reliable user experience.

2) Replace selected images across the homepage, services, partners, and profile pages

4) Adjust page layouts and formatting for a cleaner desktop and mobile view
5) Update forms, buttons, and links, including the appointment button flow
6) Add client/partner logos provided by our team
7) Rebrand the Corporate Wellness Department page, including page name, wording, visuals, layout, and menu labels

Requirements:

1) Strong experience with WordPress website editing and development
2) Ability to work with custom code when needed, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic PHP
3) Good eye for clean, professional design
4) Ability to follow a detailed edits document carefully
5) Experience with responsive desktop and mobile updates
6) Ability to edit links, forms, buttons, images, and page content
7) Clear communication and regular progress updates

Deliverables:

1) All website edits completed according to the provided document
2) Rebranded Corporate Wellness Department page
3) Desktop and mobile review of all updated pages
4) Forms, links, and appointment button tested
5) Final quality check before completion

We will provide the full edits document, replacement images, logos, new branding direction, and any additional content needed.

title: Senior WooCommerce Developer to Modernize an Existing E-commerce Website
description:
Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to review my project.
I am looking for a professional and experienced WordPress/WooCommerce developer who enjoys building high-quality websites and values long-term collaboration.
This project is very important to me. My goal is not simply to create another WooCommerce store, but to build a modern, fast, secure and scalable e-commerce platform that will represent my company for many years.
Because of that, I believe the project should be built with careful planning, clear communication and attention to detail—not rushed or treated as a quick job.
Quality is far more important to me than speed.
I am not looking for a solution where dozens of plugins are installed without consideration or where AI does most of the work automatically. AI can certainly be used as a tool for research, debugging and improving productivity, but I expect the website to be professionally designed, developed, reviewed and tested by an experienced developer. I value clean architecture, maintainable code and thoughtful implementation over shortcuts.

title: Wordpress Woocommerce Speed Optimization
description:
**Job Title:** WordPress Performance & MySQL Database Optimization Specialist

We're looking for an experienced WordPress performance expert to optimize our website's MySQL database and significantly improve page load speed and overall user experience.

### Project Overview

Our website is built on WordPress with WooCommerce and serves a large product catalog. We're looking for someone who can identify performance bottlenecks, optimize the database, and improve frontend and backend performance without breaking existing functionality.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze and optimize the MySQL database for maximum performance.
* Identify and remove unnecessary database overhead (revisions, transients, orphaned data, etc.).
* Optimize slow SQL queries and improve query execution times.
* Review and optimize WordPress database indexes where appropriate.
* Audit plugins and identify database-intensive operations.
* Improve WordPress backend responsiveness.
* Optimize page load times and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement caching strategies (database, object cache, page cache) when appropriate.
* Optimize WooCommerce performance for large product catalogs.
* Review server configuration and recommend improvements if needed.
* Ensure all optimizations are safe, documented, and reversible.

### Required Skills

* Advanced MySQL optimization.
* Strong WordPress and WooCommerce experience.
* Experience profiling slow queries using tools such as Query Monitor, MySQL EXPLAIN, or similar.
* Knowledge of Redis, Memcached, or object caching.
* Familiarity with LiteSpeed, Nginx, or Apache optimization.
* Experience with PHP performance optimization.
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance best practices.

### Nice to Have

* Experience with large WooCommerce stores.
* Experience optimizing Elementor-based websites.
* Knowledge of Cloudflare/CDNs.
* Linux server administration experience.

### Deliverables

* Full performance audit with identified bottlenecks.
* Optimized MySQL database.
* Improved WordPress backend speed.
* Faster frontend loading times.
* Before-and-after performance metrics (PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar).
* Documentation of all changes made.

### What We're Looking For

Please include:

* Examples of WordPress websites you've optimized.
* Before-and-after performance improvements you've achieved.
* Your approach to database optimization.
* Estimated timeline.
* Your hourly rate or fixed project price.

We're looking for someone who focuses on long-term performance improvements—not just installing caching plugins. The ideal candidate understands how WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL, PHP, and the hosting environment work together to deliver a fast, reliable user experience.

title: Senior WordPress Developer / Architect for Custom Content Platform
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Senior WordPress Developer who has experience building database-driven platforms, not standard business websites.

This project is not about creating pages with a premium theme. It is about designing a scalable content platform where every page is generated dynamically from structured data.

To keep the project generic, imagine the platform is about cars (the actual niche will be shared privately).

The platform combines:

* A Wikipedia-style knowledge base
* Rich media (professional photos and videos)
* A WooCommerce marketplace
* Advanced search and filtering
* Strong relationships between all content

How it should work

The frontend consists of reusable layouts and content blocks.

For example, there is one template for every Car page. (THE ACTUAL SUBJECT IS NOT ABOUT CARS THOUGH)

When I add a new car in the backend, I simply complete a structured form:

* Name
* Description
* History
* Specifications
* Images
* Videos
* Related Models
* Related Brands
* Related Articles

After clicking Publish, the system automatically:

* Creates the page using the predefined layout
* Adds it to the correct archives
* Includes it in search results
* Makes it available in filters
* Displays it in related content sections
* Connects it to all related content types

No manual page building.

No copying layouts.

Everything should be dynamic.

What I’m looking for

I’m looking for someone who understands:

* WordPress architecture
* Custom Post Types
* Advanced Custom Fields Pro
* Dynamic Templates
* Content Relationships
* Bricks Builder (preferred)
* WooCommerce
* Scalable architecture
* Performance optimization

This project should be built as a platform that can continue growing for years without changing the underlying architecture.

When applying, please answer:

1. Have you built a similar database-driven WordPress platform?
2. Which technologies would you use and why?
3. How would you structure the Custom Post Types and relationships?
4. If this platform eventually contains thousands of entries, how would you ensure it remains fast and easy to manage?

Please include examples of relevant work. Generic proposals will be ignored.

title: Wordpress Woocommerce Speed Optimization
description:
**Job Title:** WordPress Performance & MySQL Database Optimization Specialist

We're looking for an experienced WordPress performance expert to optimize our website's MySQL database and significantly improve page load speed and overall user experience.

### Project Overview

Our website is built on WordPress with WooCommerce and serves a large product catalog. We're looking for someone who can identify performance bottlenecks, optimize the database, and improve frontend and backend performance without breaking existing functionality.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze and optimize the MySQL database for maximum performance.
* Identify and remove unnecessary database overhead (revisions, transients, orphaned data, etc.).
* Optimize slow SQL queries and improve query execution times.
* Review and optimize WordPress database indexes where appropriate.
* Audit plugins and identify database-intensive operations.
* Improve WordPress backend responsiveness.
* Optimize page load times and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement caching strategies (database, object cache, page cache) when appropriate.
* Optimize WooCommerce performance for large product catalogs.
* Review server configuration and recommend improvements if needed.
* Ensure all optimizations are safe, documented, and reversible.

### Required Skills

* Advanced MySQL optimization.
* Strong WordPress and WooCommerce experience.
* Experience profiling slow queries using tools such as Query Monitor, MySQL EXPLAIN, or similar.
* Knowledge of Redis, Memcached, or object caching.
* Familiarity with LiteSpeed, Nginx, or Apache optimization.
* Experience with PHP performance optimization.
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance best practices.

### Nice to Have

* Experience with large WooCommerce stores.
* Experience optimizing Elementor-based websites.
* Knowledge of Cloudflare/CDNs.
* Linux server administration experience.

### Deliverables

* Full performance audit with identified bottlenecks.
* Optimized MySQL database.
* Improved WordPress backend speed.
* Faster frontend loading times.
* Before-and-after performance metrics (PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar).
* Documentation of all changes made.

### What We're Looking For

Please include:

* Examples of WordPress websites you've optimized.
* Before-and-after performance improvements you've achieved.
* Your approach to database optimization.
* Estimated timeline.
* Your hourly rate or fixed project price.

We're looking for someone who focuses on long-term performance improvements—not just installing caching plugins. The ideal candidate understands how WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL, PHP, and the hosting environment work together to deliver a fast, reliable user experience.

title: Experienced WordPress Developer Needed for White-Label Hotel Booking Platform
description:
About Viajar Libremente

Viajar Libremente is a travel company focused on meaningful travel experiences throughout Latin America. Our mission is to connect travelers with authentic destinations while supporting local communities through responsible tourism.

We’re expanding our website by integrating a white-label hotel booking platform through one of our travel technology partners. This will allow travelers to search for and reserve hotels directly through the Viajar Libremente website while maintaining our own brand and customer experience.

We’re looking for a dependable WordPress developer who enjoys building long-term relationships and wants to help us create something meaningful.

⸻

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced WordPress developer to integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.

Our website is already live, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable working within an existing production environment while preserving the site’s current functionality, branding, and performance.

This is intended to be the beginning of a long-term working relationship as Viajar Libremente continues to expand its travel platform.

⸻

Responsibilities

* Integrate a third-party white-label hotel booking platform into our existing WordPress website.
* Collaborate with our internal team and our travel technology partner throughout the implementation process.
* Participate in virtual meetings as needed.
* Test the integration before launch.
* Help ensure the booking experience is responsive, user-friendly, and reliable.
* Recommend improvements that enhance the user experience while maintaining our existing brand identity.
* Document any custom development for future maintenance.

⸻

Required Qualifications

* Strong WordPress development experience.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs or white-label platforms.
* Comfortable working on an existing live WordPress website.
* Comfortable attending virtual meetings with internal team members and external development partners.
* Conversational English and Spanish.
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Open to collaboration, constructive feedback, and an iterative development process.

Preferred Qualifications

* Based in Colombia (preferred, not required), as occasional in-person collaboration may become beneficial as the project grows.
* Experience with travel websites, booking engines, reservation systems, or WooCommerce.
* UI/UX experience.
* Website performance optimization experience.

⸻

Budget

Budget: Approximately $15 USD/hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and proposed approach.

We recognize that every developer brings different experience and strengths. If you believe you’re an excellent fit for this project, we’d love to hear why.

Expected Start: We anticipate beginning Phase 1 (Discovery & Planning) in August 2026. Phase 2 (Development & Integration) will begin after the implementation plan has been reviewed and approved.

Project Phases

Phase 1 – Discovery & Planning

Before development begins, we’d like to work together to:

* Review the API documentation.
* Review the existing website.
* Meet virtually with our team.
* Meet with our technology partner if needed.
* Develop an implementation plan.
* Identify technical considerations and potential challenges.
* Recommend a project timeline and milestone schedule.

This phase allows both parties to determine whether we’re a good long-term fit before moving into implementation.

⸻

Phase 2 – Development & Integration

Following approval of the implementation plan, the selected developer will:

* Complete the hotel booking integration.
* Assist with testing and quality assurance.
* Resolve bugs and technical issues.
* Prepare the website for launch.
* Provide documentation for future maintenance.

⸻

To Apply

Please include:

* A brief introduction about yourself.
* Your WordPress experience.
* Examples of similar API integrations or booking platform projects.
* Links to your portfolio.
* Why you believe you’re a good fit for this project.
* Your estimated timeline after reviewing the project requirements.

To help us identify applicants who have carefully read the project description, please begin your proposal with the words: “Viajar Libremente.”

⸻

About Our Culture

We’re looking for more than someone who can write code.

We value honesty, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re building Viajar Libremente for the long term and want to work with people who take pride in producing quality work while helping bring meaningful ideas to life.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior WooCommerce Developer to Modernize an Existing E-commerce Website
description:
Hello,
Thank you for taking the time to review my project.
I am looking for a professional and experienced WordPress/WooCommerce developer who enjoys building high-quality websites and values long-term collaboration.
This project is very important to me. My goal is not simply to create another WooCommerce store, but to build a modern, fast, secure and scalable e-commerce platform that will represent my company for many years.
Because of that, I believe the project should be built with careful planning, clear communication and attention to detail—not rushed or treated as a quick job.
Quality is far more important to me than speed.
I am not looking for a solution where dozens of plugins are installed without consideration or where AI does most of the work automatically. AI can certainly be used as a tool for research, debugging and improving productivity, but I expect the website to be professionally designed, developed, reviewed and tested by an experienced developer. I value clean architecture, maintainable code and thoughtful implementation over shortcuts.
Whenever possible, I prefer lightweight, well-written solutions instead of adding unnecessary plugins. Every plugin should have a clear purpose and should only be installed after discussion and approval.
The website should be secure, responsive, SEO-friendly, optimized for performance and easy to maintain in the future.
I already own the domain, hosting, WordPress installation and all related accounts, and I expect to retain full ownership and administrator access throughout the entire project.
To keep the project organized and transparent, I would like to divide it into approximately four milestones. Each milestone will contain clearly defined deliverables, and payment will only be released after the work has been completed, reviewed and approved.
My initial idea is:
Milestone 1 – Planning & Design
•	Review the existing website
•	Discuss the project requirements
•	Finalize the design direction
•	Create a development plan
Milestone 2 – Core Development
•	Build the agreed functionality
•	WooCommerce configuration
•	Product structure
•	Supplier integrations
•	Main website development
Milestone 3 – Optimization & Testing
•	Performance optimization
•	SEO improvements
•	Bug fixing
•	Security enhancements
•	Cross-device and browser testing
Milestone 4 – Final Delivery
•	Final review
•	Documentation
•	Migration to the live website
•	Final adjustments
•	Project completion
This approach allows both of us to monitor progress, discuss improvements and ensure that every stage meets the expected quality before moving on to the next.
If we decide to work together, I will ask you to review and sign a Software Development Agreement before the project begins. The agreement will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the selection process.
I have attached a detailed Project Scope describing the website, its requirements and the overall project objectives, along with a design reference image illustrating the style and user experience we are aiming for.
Please take your time to review them. If you have any questions, suggestions or recommendations, I would be happy to discuss them. I appreciate developers who share their experience and contribute ideas that improve the final result.
I am not looking for the cheapest developer—I am looking for the right developer. Professionalism, quality, communication and reliability are much more important to me than simply choosing the lowest hourly rate.
If you believe you are the right person for this project, I look forward to hearing from you and hopefully building a successful long-term collaboration together.

title: Wordpress Woocommerce Speed Optimization
description:
**Job Title:** WordPress Performance & MySQL Database Optimization Specialist

We're looking for an experienced WordPress performance expert to optimize our website's MySQL database and significantly improve page load speed and overall user experience.

### Project Overview

Our website is built on WordPress with WooCommerce and serves a large product catalog. We're looking for someone who can identify performance bottlenecks, optimize the database, and improve frontend and backend performance without breaking existing functionality.

### Responsibilities

* Analyze and optimize the MySQL database for maximum performance.
* Identify and remove unnecessary database overhead (revisions, transients, orphaned data, etc.).
* Optimize slow SQL queries and improve query execution times.
* Review and optimize WordPress database indexes where appropriate.
* Audit plugins and identify database-intensive operations.
* Improve WordPress backend responsiveness.
* Optimize page load times and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement caching strategies (database, object cache, page cache) when appropriate.
* Optimize WooCommerce performance for large product catalogs.
* Review server configuration and recommend improvements if needed.
* Ensure all optimizations are safe, documented, and reversible.

### Required Skills

* Advanced MySQL optimization.
* Strong WordPress and WooCommerce experience.
* Experience profiling slow queries using tools such as Query Monitor, MySQL EXPLAIN, or similar.
* Knowledge of Redis, Memcached, or object caching.
* Familiarity with LiteSpeed, Nginx, or Apache optimization.
* Experience with PHP performance optimization.
* Understanding of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance best practices.

### Nice to Have

* Experience with large WooCommerce stores.
* Experience optimizing Elementor-based websites.
* Knowledge of Cloudflare/CDNs.
* Linux server administration experience.

### Deliverables

* Full performance audit with identified bottlenecks.
* Optimized MySQL database.
* Improved WordPress backend speed.
* Faster frontend loading times.
* Before-and-after performance metrics (PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar).
* Documentation of all changes made.

### What We're Looking For

Please include:

* Examples of WordPress websites you've optimized.
* Before-and-after performance improvements you've achieved.
* Your approach to database optimization.
* Estimated timeline.
* Your hourly rate or fixed project price.

We're looking for someone who focuses on long-term performance improvements—not just installing caching plugins. The ideal candidate understands how WordPress, WooCommerce, MySQL, PHP, and the hosting environment work together to deliver a fast, reliable user experience.

title: Senior WordPress Developer / Architect for Custom Content Platform
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Senior WordPress Developer who has experience building database-driven platforms, not standard business websites.

To keep the project generic, imagine the platform is about cars (the actual niche will be shared privately).

The platform combines:

* A Wikipedia-style knowledge base
* Rich media (professional photos and videos)
* A WooCommerce marketplace
* Advanced search and filtering
* Strong relationships between all content

How it should work

The frontend consists of reusable layouts and content blocks.

For example, there is one template for every Car page. (THE ACTUAL SUBJECT IS NOT ABOUT CARS THOUGH)

When I add a new car in the backend, I simply complete a structured form:

* Name
* Description
* History
* Specifications
* Images
* Videos
* Related Models
* Related Brands
* Related Articles

After clicking Publish, the system automatically:

* Creates the page using the predefined layout
* Adds it to the correct archives
* Includes it in search results
* Makes it available in filters
* Displays it in related content sections
* Connects it to all related content types

No manual page building.

No copying layouts.

Everything should be dynamic.

What I’m looking for

I’m looking for someone who understands:

* WordPress architecture
* Custom Post Types
* Advanced Custom Fields Pro
* Dynamic Templates
* Content Relationships
* Bricks Builder (preferred)
* WooCommerce
* Scalable architecture
* Performance optimization

This project should be built as a platform that can continue growing for years without changing the underlying architecture.

When applying, please answer:

1. Have you built a similar database-driven WordPress platform?
2. Which technologies would you use and why?
3. How would you structure the Custom Post Types and relationships?
4. If this platform eventually contains thousands of entries, how would you ensure it remains fast and easy to manage?

Please include examples of relevant work. Generic proposals will be ignored.

The ideal candidate has experience designing:

SaaS applications
Content Management Systems (CMS)
Administrative dashboards
Marketing platforms
Business applications
Design systems and reusable UI libraries

Dashboard layout
Navigation
Analytics widgets
Search experience
Notifications
User profile experience
Mobile responsiveness
Overall information architecture

Design intuitive interfaces for managing:

Website pages
Product catalogs
Service pages
Media library
SEO tools
Forms
User administration
AI-powered content tools
Publishing workflows

The concept should include:

Homepage
Interior page
Product page
Service page
Mobile layouts
Responsive behavior
Modern UI components

Rather than producing a single custom design, the objective is to establish a flexible visual framework that can be adapted across future client projects.

This includes defining:

Typography
Color palettes
Icons
Buttons
Forms
Cards
Navigation styles
Grid system
Spacing standards
Reusable interface components

Design handoff standards
Component libraries
Figma organization
Design tokens
Reusable templates
Developer-ready specifications
Version control for design assets
AI-assisted design workflows
Opportunities to streamline future website production

Extensive UI/UX design experience
Strong portfolio of SaaS or CMS applications
Advanced Figma skills
Experience building design systems
Knowledge of responsive web design
Understanding of accessibility best practices
Ability to work closely with developers and product stakeholders
Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred experience includes:

Laravel or Filament-based applications
Administrative dashboard design
AI-assisted design tools
Product strategy
B2B software platforms
Industrial or manufacturing-related applications
Deliverables

The selected designer will work collaboratively with our internal team to produce:

CoreContent 2.0 dashboard design
Complete administrative UI/UX concepts
Front-end website concept
Responsive layouts
Design system
Component library
Style guide
Developer handoff documentation
Recommendations for improving our long-term design workflow

* A Wikipedia-style knowledge base
* Rich media (professional photos and videos)
* A WooCommerce marketplace

For example, there is one template for every Car page. (THE ACTUAL SUBJECT IS NOT ABOUT CARS THOUGH)

* Name
* Description
* History
* Specifications
* Images
* Videos
* Related Models
* Related Brands
* Related Articles

* Creates the page using the predefined layout
* Adds it to the correct archives
* Includes it in search results
* Makes it available in filters
* Displays it in related content sections
* Connects it to all related content types

No manual page building.

No copying layouts.

Everything should be dynamic.

* WordPress architecture
* Custom Post Types
* Advanced Custom Fields Pro
* Dynamic Templates
* Content Relationships

What you'll do
Rebuild the site structure to a new architecture: 1 homepage, 3 category "hub" pages, ~15 product pages, and 3 support pages (About, Request a Quote, Resources). Full sitemap provided.
Add all page content I provide (paste-in from my spec doc) — including a specs table and FAQ section on each product page. Each product page also needs a downloadable data-sheet (PDF) button/link (I provide the PDFs), similar to a distributor product page. Set these up so I can add/swap data sheets easily.

Set title tags + meta descriptions for every page using Rank Math or Yoast SEO (I provide the exact tags).

The form and product pages should display minimum-order-quantity language (I provide the exact wording — orders are by full carton/bundle quantities with a minimum order value).
Add product schema markup on product pages.

Complete site spec (XLSX/PDF): architecture, every page's title tag + meta description + copy, About page, homepage copy, quote-form fields, minimum-order language, and CTA placement.
Product spec sheets (part numbers, sizes, materials, finishes, package counts) for the product tables.

WordPress admin + hosting access (EasyWP / Namecheap).

Proven WordPress experience (please share 2-3 similar builds).

Tell me your recommendation and why. Either way, pages must end up clean, fast, mobile-first, with title tags/meta editable via Rank Math or Yoast.
Comfortable with Rank Math or Yoast, redirect plugins, product schema, and building lead-gen forms with file upload.
Good communication; I'll provide everything organized.
Nice to have
Basic on-page SEO knowledge (hub/pillar internal linking — I'll specify, but bonus if you understand it).
Scope notes
This is a build/migration job, not an ongoing SEO campaign. (I'll hire separately for backlinks/ongoing SEO once the pages are live — see below.)
~22 pages total. Content is written and provided. Design can reuse the existing site's look or lightly refresh it.
Budget & timeline
Fixed price: $500. Please quote against this scope (~22 pages, content provided).
Timeline: [your window, e.g. 2-3 weeks].
To apply
Share 2-3 relevant WordPress builds.
Confirm you're comfortable with: Rank Math/Yoast, 301 redirects, product schema, quote forms with file upload, and page-wide CTAs.
Confirm whether you'd keep Brizy or recommend a different builder/theme (and why).
One line on how you'd handle the old-URL → new-URL redirects.

title: WordPress Rebuild — Repurpose Existing Site to New Product Line (RSU Supply)
description:
WordPress Rebuild — Repurpose Existing Site to New Product Line (RSU Supply)
Overview

I own an existing WordPress site (rsusupply.com), currently built with the Brizy page builder. It was originally built for a different product line, and I'm repurposing it for construction hardware for contractors (strut channel, pipe hangers, threaded rod). The site is already live and looks good — I need someone to rebuild the page structure and content around the new products, set up the SEO tags, add strong calls-to-action, and handle redirects cleanly.

I will provide all content — page copy, titles, meta descriptions, product specs, FAQs, and the quote-form fields — in a complete spec document. You are building the shell and wiring it up, not writing content. This keeps the job fast and well-defined.

What you'll do
Rebuild the site structure to a new architecture: 1 homepage, 3 category "hub" pages, ~15 product pages, and 3 support pages (About, Request a Quote, Resources). Full sitemap provided.
Add all page content I provide (paste-in from my spec doc) — including a specs table and FAQ section on each product page. Each product page also needs a downloadable data-sheet (PDF) button/link (I provide the PDFs), similar to a distributor product page. Set these up so I can add/swap data sheets easily.
Add clear calls-to-action on EVERY page — specifically "Request a Price Sheet" and "Request a Quote" buttons (plus a click-to-call phone link). These should be prominent on every product and hub page, not just the contact page. (This is a key requirement — I want no page where a contractor can't immediately request pricing.)
Set title tags + meta descriptions for every page using Rank Math or Yoast SEO (I provide the exact tags).
Remove all old content (old product pages, images, copy) and set 301 redirects from any old URLs to the new pages (or homepage). Use the Redirection plugin or Rank Math redirects.
Build a "Request a Quote" form with specific fields I provide (contact + company + project + order-size vetting fields), including an optional file-upload field (contractors can upload a materials list / price sheet / invoice — restrict to PDF/JPG/PNG/XLSX/CSV with a size cap). The form and product pages should display minimum-order-quantity language (I provide the exact wording — orders are by full carton/bundle quantities with a minimum order value).
Add product schema markup on product pages.
Install/configure: Rank Math (or Yoast), a caching plugin (for Core Web Vitals), and a redirect plugin.
Regenerate the XML sitemap and submit it to Google Search Console. Set up Google Search Console + Google Analytics if not already connected.
Make sure the whole site is mobile-responsive and fast.
What I provide
Complete site spec (XLSX/PDF): architecture, every page's title tag + meta description + copy, About page, homepage copy, quote-form fields, minimum-order language, and CTA placement.
Product spec sheets (part numbers, sizes, materials, finishes, package counts) for the product tables.
A logo (ram head) will be provided separately (handled outside this job).
WordPress admin + hosting access (EasyWP / Namecheap).
Requirements / must-haves
Proven WordPress experience (please share 2-3 similar builds).
The site is currently built with the Brizy page builder. You should be comfortable working in Brizy — OR, if you think a different setup (e.g. Gutenberg blocks, or a fast theme like Kadence) would be better for speed/SEO/maintainability, I'm open to suggestions. Tell me your recommendation and why. Either way, pages must end up clean, fast, mobile-first, with title tags/meta editable via Rank Math or Yoast.
Comfortable with Rank Math or Yoast, redirect plugins, product schema, and building lead-gen forms with file upload.
Good communication; I'll provide everything organized.
Nice to have
Basic on-page SEO knowledge (hub/pillar internal linking — I'll specify, but bonus if you understand it).
Scope notes
This is a build/migration job, not an ongoing SEO campaign. (I'll hire separately for backlinks/ongoing SEO once the pages are live — see below.)
~22 pages total. Content is written and provided. Design can reuse the existing site's look or lightly refresh it.
Budget & timeline
Fixed price: $500. Please quote against this scope (~22 pages, content provided).
Timeline: [your window, e.g. 2-3 weeks].
To apply
Share 2-3 relevant WordPress builds.
Confirm you're comfortable with: Rank Math/Yoast, 301 redirects, product schema, quote forms with file upload, and page-wide CTAs.
Confirm whether you'd keep Brizy or recommend a different builder/theme (and why).
One line on how you'd handle the old-URL → new-URL redirects.

title: Build 10-Page WordPress Site with Blocksy Pro
description:
I'm rebuilding the website for my digital marketing business (GrowUrBiz.com) and need an experienced WordPress developer to transfer everything into a fresh build on the Blocksy Pro theme (Business license — already purchased).

This is a low-ambiguity project. All decisions are made and all content is written. You will receive a structured, page-by-page copy brief covering all 10 pages, with every headline, subheadline, body section, CTA button label, and layout note clearly labeled — including dev notes flagging placement and layout instructions. No copywriting, no guesswork. Your job is clean, fast, accurate implementation.

Scope

- Fresh WordPress build using Blocksy Pro (theme license provided; hosting access provided)
- 10 pages built to spec from the supplied copy brief (Home, service pages, about, contact, etc.)
- Contact/lead form on relevant pages, plus a calendar booking embed for the "Free Website Checkup" CTA
- GA4 conversion tracking configured for form submissions, phone-number clicks, and booking events
- Basic on-page SEO hygiene: page titles, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, image alt text (targets provided)
- Full mobile/responsive QA across phone, tablet, desktop
- Launch support: go-live on my hosting, redirects from old URLs if needed

What I provide

- Blocksy Pro license, hosting/cPanel access, domain
- Complete copy brief (all 10 pages, dev notes included)
- Logo and brand assets
- Fast responses — I'm reachable daily and will not be a bottleneck

Milestones (quote your total; I'll split payments accordingly)

1. Theme setup + Home page built to spec and approved
2. Remaining 9 pages built
3. Forms, calendar embed, GA4 tracking verified working
4. Mobile QA + launch

Timeline

I'd like this delivered within 1–3 weeks of kickoff. Please only bid if you can commit to that window and confirm your availability in your proposal.

To apply, please answer these two questions (proposals without answers will be skipped)

1. Link to one live WordPress site you built for a local service business (contractor, clinic, law firm, salon, etc.) and tell me briefly what you were responsible for.
2. The site's primary CTA is a "Free Website Checkup" booking. How would you implement the booking flow (form vs. calendar embed vs. both), and how would you make sure each booking is tracked as a conversion in GA4?

A plus, but not required

- Prior hands-on experience with the Blocksy theme (or similar lightweight Gutenberg-first themes like Astra/GeneratePress/Kadence)
- Experience with WP Rocket/LiteSpeed or similar speed optimization
I'm looking for someone who communicates clearly, hits deadlines, and could become my go-to developer for ongoing client work — I run a web services business and this project is effectively an audition for a longer-term working relationship.

Remove all old content (old product pages, images, copy) and set 301 redirects from any old URLs to the new pages (or homepage). Use the Redirection plugin or Rank Math redirects.
Build a "Request a Quote" form with specific fields I provide (contact + company + project + order-size vetting fields), including an optional file-upload field (contractors can upload a materials list / price sheet / invoice — restrict to PDF/JPG/PNG/XLSX/CSV with a size cap). The form and product pages should display minimum-order-quantity language (I provide the exact wording — orders are by full carton/bundle quantities with a minimum order value).
Add product schema markup on product pages.
Install/configure: Rank Math (or Yoast), a caching plugin (for Core Web Vitals), and a redirect plugin.
Regenerate the XML sitemap and submit it to Google Search Console. Set up Google Search Console + Google Analytics if not already connected.
Make sure the whole site is mobile-responsive and fast.
What I provide
Complete site spec (XLSX/PDF): architecture, every page's title tag + meta description + copy, About page, homepage copy, quote-form fields, minimum-order language, and CTA placement.
Product spec sheets (part numbers, sizes, materials, finishes, package counts) for the product tables.
A logo (ram head) will be provided separately (handled outside this job).
WordPress admin + hosting access (EasyWP / Namecheap).
Requirements / must-haves
Proven WordPress experience (please share 2-3 similar builds).
The site is currently built with the Brizy page builder. You should be comfortable working in Brizy — OR, if you think a different setup (e.g. Gutenberg blocks, or a fast theme like Kadence) would be better for speed/SEO/maintainability, I'm open to suggestions. Tell me your recommendation and why. Either way, pages must end up clean, fast, mobile-first, with title tags/meta editable via Rank Math or Yoast.
Comfortable with Rank Math or Yoast, redirect plugins, product schema, and building lead-gen forms with file upload.
Good communication; I'll provide everything organized.
Nice to have
Basic on-page SEO knowledge (hub/pillar internal linking — I'll specify, but bonus if you understand it).
Scope notes
This is a build/migration job, not an ongoing SEO campaign. (I'll hire separately for backlinks/ongoing SEO once the pages are live — see below.)
~22 pages total. Content is written and provided. Design can reuse the existing site's look or lightly refresh it.
Budget & timeline
Fixed price: $500. Please quote against this scope (~22 pages, content provided).
Timeline: [your window, e.g. 2-3 weeks].
To apply
Share 2-3 relevant WordPress builds.
Confirm you're comfortable with: Rank Math/Yoast, 301 redirects, product schema, quote forms with file upload, and page-wide CTAs.
Confirm whether you'd keep Brizy or recommend a different builder/theme (and why).
One line on how you'd handle the old-URL → new-URL redirects.

title: WordPress Site Audit & Fixes: Design Consistency, Alignment, Responsiveness
description:
I need a WordPress developer to audit, document, and fix design and layout issues on an existing Elementor-built site (techxur.com).

The site has real inconsistencies that need a careful eye, not a quick pass. Examples include misaligned sections, inconsistent spacing and font usage across pages, placeholder content still live in production (team bios showing Lorem ipsum), unpopulated stat counters displaying 0, broken or dead-end buttons linking to # or empty anchors, and responsiveness problems across breakpoints. This is not a full rebuild. It is a precision cleanup of an existing Elementor site.

Phase 1: Audit and Documentation
Review the site page by page, desktop and mobile, and document every design inconsistency, alignment issue, broken element, and responsiveness problem you find. I am open to your preferred format for this (spreadsheet, annotated screenshots, Loom walkthrough, or a combination), as long as it is organized clearly enough that we can review it together and agree on scope before any fixes begin.

Phase 2: Fixes
Once we review the audit together, you will implement the fixes. Scope and cost for this phase will be finalized based on what Phase 1 uncovers.

Phase 3: QA
Final pass across all pages and breakpoints to confirm every documented issue is resolved, with a short QA report confirming what was fixed.

How I want to structure this:
Please propose your own milestone breakdown and budget allocation across these 3 phases within the $350 total. I want to see how you think about scoping a project like this, not just a bid number.

What I am looking for:
- Real experience with Elementor and WordPress, not just theme installs
- A sharp eye for design detail: spacing, alignment, typography consistency, visual hierarchy
- Experience with responsive design fixes across breakpoints
- Clear communication and organized documentation habits
- Someone comfortable proposing their own process rather than waiting to be told every step

To apply, please include:
1. Your proposed milestone and budget breakdown for the 3 phases
2. Your preferred format for the Phase 1 audit documentation
3. A brief note on 1 to 2 design or layout issues you can already spot from a quick look at techxur.com

title: WordPress/UX Builder Developer to Build Custom B2B STEM Landing Page
description:
Project Title:
WordPress / UX Builder Developer to Build B2B STEM Landing Page (HubSpot & Meta Pixel Setup)

Project Overview:
We are looking for an efficient, experienced WordPress developer proficient in Flatsome Theme & UX Builder to construct a high-converting, fully responsive landing page for our educational organization (eurekaenrichment.org) to launch our upcoming campaign.

ALL CONTENT, COPY, BRAND ASSETS, AND PAGE BLUEPRINTS ARE 100% COMPLETE AND READY FOR IMMEDIATE IMPLEMENTATION.

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Website Theme/Builder: Our site uses Flatsome Theme with UX Builder. We do NOT use Elementor or heavy third-party page builders. The page must be built natively inside UX Builder.
- Lead System & CRM: Integrate the landing page lead form with HubSpot Free CRM to store contact entries, trigger an automated confirmation email, and embed a HubSpot Free Meetings scheduling widget for School Administrators.
- Meta Business Suite / Pixel Tracking: Configure Meta Pixel conversion event tracking on form submissions so we can track campaign metrics accurately.

Key Deliverables:
1. Native UX Builder Layout: Construct the full page natively using UX Builder components (Hero slides, dual-track feature grids, High School FTC pathway, partner authority badges, parent referral block, and legal footer).
2. Official Brand Styling & Typography:
   - Apply provided Eureka brand guidelines (complete brand kit with exact hex colors, typography specs, and logo assets will be supplied upon hire).
3. Conditional Form & HubSpot Integration: Build a multi-role lead form with conditional logic. Selecting "School Administrator" should conditionally direct/route the user to book a meeting via an embedded HubSpot Meetings widget.
4. Auto-Responder: Set up an automated email confirmation upon form submission.
5. Tracking Setup: Install/verify Meta Pixel tracking events on form completions.
6. Mobile & Speed Optimization: Ensure fast load times and crisp responsiveness across mobile devices.
7. SEO: Apply provided meta titles and meta descriptions.

To Apply:
Please answer the following in your proposal:
1. Share 2-3 examples of WordPress pages you have built specifically using UX Builder / Flatsome.
2. Confirm your experience with HubSpot CRM integrations and Meta Pixel event setup in WordPress.
3. Confirm that you can execute this build within our fixed budget and achieve a live launch ideally within 1 week. Open to discussion on project timeline and estimations.

Overview

We are building thandiani.pk, an SEO-focused destination guide for a mountain destination in northern Pakistan. All content (six pillar pages, blog copy, sitemap and architecture) needs to be written. We need a developer to build the site to a high standard, and to build a lightweight AI monitoring tool that tracks new web mentions of the destination and generates SEO-ready draft content packs for our review.

title: WordPress Developer Needed to Convert Custom Pages to Gutenberg Block Editor
description:
Project Overview:

Born This Way Foundation is seeking an experienced WordPress developer to help transition portions of three existing websites from hard-coded page structures to a more flexible Gutenberg Block Editor experience.

This is not a website redesign. Our goal is to preserve the existing design while making it easier for our internal team to update content, layouts, images, and calls-to-action without requiring developer support for routine changes.

Websites: 

1. Born This Way Foundation :(https://bornthisway.foundation/)

2. Channel Kindness: (https://www.channelkindness.org/)

3. #BeKind365:
(https://bekind365.world/)

Scope of Work

We're looking for someone who can:

• Convert hard-coded page layouts into editable Gutenberg blocks.
• Create reusable page components for non-technical staff.
• Preserve the existing front-end design.
• Improve long-term maintainability and support accessibility best practices.

Examples of updates we'd like to manage internally include:

• Updating images and graphics
• Swapping calls-to-action
• Showing or hiding page sections
• Editing messaging
• Reordering content
• Updating team member pages

We'll likely begin with a small pilot project of updating up to two pages.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with experience in:

• WordPress development
• Gutenberg Block Editor
• Custom blocks and/or ACF
• PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Responsive development
• WCAG/ADA accessibility

Experience modernizing existing WordPress websites is strongly preferred.

Proposal Requirements

Please include:

• Relevant WordPress portfolio examples
• Experience converting custom WordPress pages to Gutenberg
• Your recommended technical approach
•Estimated hours for:

1. Converting a typical page
2. Converting an entire website
3. Whether you prefer hourly or fixed-price work
4. Your hourly rate or fixed price
5. Your availability
