title: Build an SEO Destination Website (WordPress) + AI Content-Monitoring Tool: Tourism Niche, Pakistan
description:
This job is for anyone based in Pakistan only - or if anyone understands the local language, towns etc.

Overview

We are building thandiani.pk, an SEO-focused destination guide for a mountain destination in northern Pakistan. All content (six pillar pages, blog copy, sitemap and architecture) needs to be written. We need a developer to build the site to a high standard, and to build a lightweight AI monitoring tool that tracks new web mentions of the destination and generates SEO-ready draft content packs for our review.

This is a two-milestone, hourly rate project. Bid for both, but each milestone is approved and paid independently.

Milestone 1:
WordPress build (or propose an alternative CMS with justification) on hosting we provide
Six pillar pages + blog hub with five categories, per the site architecture
Clean, fast, mobile-first design; Core Web Vitals in the green; image optimisation and lazy loading
Full on-page SEO setup: schema markup (Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb), meta fields, XML sitemap, Search Console and GA4 connected
Blog templates designed for recurring post formats (e.g. monthly report posts)
A simple ad/featured-placement slot system on designated pages (dormant at launch, activatable later)
Admin training: a 30-minute handover call and a short written guide so our team can publish without you

Milestone 2:

A tool that does three things on a schedule (daily or weekly):

Scans the web: news, blogs, YouTube, and social where feasible for new publications and mentions of our destination and defined related keywords
Summarises each finding: source, link, what it's about, and why it matters (or doesn't)
Generates an SEO-ready draft pack for items worth responding to: suggested angle, target keywords, headline options, and a draft outline or post, delivered to us by email, dashboard, or Google Doc for human review before anything is published.

We are open on implementation (n8n, Make, custom Python + LLM API, etc.): propose your stack and explain why. Nothing publishes automatically; the tool suggests, we approve. Must run on our accounts/keys and be documented well enough that we are not dependent on you to operate it.

WordPress / UX Builder Developer to Build B2B STEM Landing Page (HubSpot & Meta Pixel Setup)

Project Overview:
We are looking for an efficient, experienced WordPress developer proficient in Flatsome Theme & UX Builder to construct a high-converting, fully responsive landing page for our educational organization (eurekaenrichment.org) to launch our upcoming campaign.

ALL CONTENT, COPY, BRAND ASSETS, AND PAGE BLUEPRINTS ARE 100% COMPLETE AND READY FOR IMMEDIATE IMPLEMENTATION.

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Website Theme/Builder: Our site uses Flatsome Theme with UX Builder. We do NOT use Elementor or heavy third-party page builders. The page must be built natively inside UX Builder.
- Lead System & CRM: Integrate the landing page lead form with HubSpot Free CRM to store contact entries, trigger an automated confirmation email, and embed a HubSpot Free Meetings scheduling widget for School Administrators.
- Meta Business Suite / Pixel Tracking: Configure Meta Pixel conversion event tracking on form submissions so we can track campaign metrics accurately.

Key Deliverables:
1. Native UX Builder Layout: Construct the full page natively using UX Builder components (Hero slides, dual-track feature grids, High School FTC pathway, partner authority badges, parent referral block, and legal footer).
2. Official Brand Styling & Typography:
   - Apply provided Eureka brand guidelines (complete brand kit with exact hex colors, typography specs, and logo assets will be supplied upon hire).
3. Conditional Form & HubSpot Integration: Build a multi-role lead form with conditional logic. Selecting "School Administrator" should conditionally direct/route the user to book a meeting via an embedded HubSpot Meetings widget.
4. Auto-Responder: Set up an automated email confirmation upon form submission.
5. Tracking Setup: Install/verify Meta Pixel tracking events on form completions.
6. Mobile & Speed Optimization: Ensure fast load times and crisp responsiveness across mobile devices.
7. SEO: Apply provided meta titles and meta descriptions.

To Apply:
Please answer the following in your proposal:
1. Share 2-3 examples of WordPress pages you have built specifically using UX Builder / Flatsome.
2. Confirm your experience with HubSpot CRM integrations and Meta Pixel event setup in WordPress.
3. Confirm that you can execute this build within our fixed budget and achieve a live launch ideally within 1 week. Open to discussion on project timeline and estimations.

title: Build an SEO Destination Website (WordPress) + AI Content-Monitoring Tool: Tourism Niche, Pakistan
description:
This job is for anyone based in Pakistan only - or if anyone understands the local language, towns etc.

Overview

We are building thandiani.pk, an SEO-focused destination guide for a mountain destination in northern Pakistan. All content (six pillar pages, blog copy, sitemap and architecture) needs to be written. We need a developer to build the site to a high standard, and to build a lightweight AI monitoring tool that tracks new web mentions of the destination and generates SEO-ready draft content packs for our review.

This is a two-milestone, hourly rate project. Bid for both, but each milestone is approved and paid independently.

Milestone 1:
WordPress build (or propose an alternative CMS with justification) on hosting we provide
Six pillar pages + blog hub with five categories, per the site architecture
Clean, fast, mobile-first design; Core Web Vitals in the green; image optimisation and lazy loading
Full on-page SEO setup: schema markup (Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb), meta fields, XML sitemap, Search Console and GA4 connected
Blog templates designed for recurring post formats (e.g. monthly report posts)
A simple ad/featured-placement slot system on designated pages (dormant at launch, activatable later)
Admin training: a 30-minute handover call and a short written guide so our team can publish without you

Milestone 2:

A tool that does three things on a schedule (daily or weekly):

Scans the web: news, blogs, YouTube, and social where feasible for new publications and mentions of our destination and defined related keywords
Summarises each finding: source, link, what it's about, and why it matters (or doesn't)
Generates an SEO-ready draft pack for items worth responding to: suggested angle, target keywords, headline options, and a draft outline or post, delivered to us by email, dashboard, or Google Doc for human review before anything is published.

We are open on implementation (n8n, Make, custom Python + LLM API, etc.): propose your stack and explain why. Nothing publishes automatically; the tool suggests, we approve. Must run on our accounts/keys and be documented well enough that we are not dependent on you to operate it.

title: WordPress Developer Needed to Convert Custom Pages to Gutenberg Block Editor
description:
Project Overview:

Born This Way Foundation is seeking an experienced WordPress developer to help transition portions of three existing websites from hard-coded page structures to a more flexible Gutenberg Block Editor experience.

This is not a website redesign. Our goal is to preserve the existing design while making it easier for our internal team to update content, layouts, images, and calls-to-action without requiring developer support for routine changes.

Websites: 

1. Born This Way Foundation :(https://bornthisway.foundation/)

2. Channel Kindness: (https://www.channelkindness.org/)

3. #BeKind365:
(https://bekind365.world/)

Scope of Work

We're looking for someone who can:

• Convert hard-coded page layouts into editable Gutenberg blocks.
• Create reusable page components for non-technical staff.
• Preserve the existing front-end design.
• Improve long-term maintainability and support accessibility best practices.

Examples of updates we'd like to manage internally include:

• Updating images and graphics
• Swapping calls-to-action
• Showing or hiding page sections
• Editing messaging
• Reordering content
• Updating team member pages

We'll likely begin with a small pilot project of updating up to two pages.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with experience in:

• WordPress development
• Gutenberg Block Editor
• Custom blocks and/or ACF
• PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Responsive development
• WCAG/ADA accessibility

Experience modernizing existing WordPress websites is strongly preferred.

Proposal Requirements

Please include:

• Relevant WordPress portfolio examples
• Experience converting custom WordPress pages to Gutenberg
• Your recommended technical approach
•Estimated hours for:

1. Converting a typical page
2. Converting an entire website
3. Whether you prefer hourly or fixed-price work
4. Your hourly rate or fixed price
5. Your availability

title: WordPress + WooCommerce Developer — Launch Storefront for API-Imported Digital Products
description:
We're launching an online store selling digital prepaid service plans — virtual products, delivered electronically after purchase, with no physical shipping. We do not have a website yet, so this is a build from zero.

Our supplier provides a WordPress plugin that imports the product catalog via their API and handles order fulfilment and delivery emails. Payment will run through a standard WooCommerce payment gateway.

Your job is to stand the site up, configure it properly, and — most importantly — make the product browsing and purchase experience genuinely good, because the supplier's out-of-the-box presentation is basic.

Scope of work:

Install and configure WordPress + WooCommerce on our hosting
Install and configure the supplier's catalog-import plugin (we'll provide it and its documentation)
Select and set up a suitable theme, using a child theme for all customization
Customize the product page UX — products come in multiple options (e.g. size and duration); we need customers to select one option and then choose a quantity, plus the ability to group/filter options by type
Improve product search — WooCommerce's default search is not good enough for our catalog
Integrate a payment gateway, customer accounts, and transactional emails
Basic responsive/mobile polish and essential SEO hygiene
Handover: documentation and a short walkthrough

Important technical context:

The supplier plugin re-syncs the catalog periodically and overwrites product data. Any customization must survive re-syncs and plugin updates — no editing plugin or theme core files.
We're open to either custom development or an off-the-shelf plugin for the product-page UX. If a ready-made solution does the job well, we'd prefer it — tell us which and why.
We are technically informed: we've reviewed the supplier plugin's behaviour in detail and have a UI mock of the target product page, which we'll share with shortlisted candidates.
What we provide

Hosting, domain, the supplier plugin and credentials, the UI mock, brand assets, and fast decision-making on our side.

Required skills:

Deep, demonstrable WooCommerce experience (not just general WordPress)
Strong grasp of WooCommerce product types and when to use each
Comfortable with PHP, hooks/filters, child themes, and template overrides
Experience integrating third-party/API-driven plugins
Payment gateway setup; clean, responsive front-end work

Your proposal must include (proposals without these will not be reviewed):

Your recommended approach — custom build vs. off-the-shelf plugin, and the reasoning
A realistic timeline with milestones (in days/weeks) — we value realistic over optimistic, but short timelines with a credible plan will win
What you need from us to start and to avoid delays
Pricing — fixed price preferred, with milestones
2–3 links to live WooCommerce sites you've built, ideally with customized product pages

description:

title: AI-Powered Scalp Analysis Quiz for Shopify (Wellina Theme)

title: WordPress + WooCommerce Developer — Launch Storefront for API-Imported Digital Products
description:
We're launching an online store selling digital prepaid service plans — virtual products, delivered electronically after purchase, with no physical shipping. We do not have a website yet, so this is a build from zero.

Our supplier provides a WordPress plugin that imports the product catalog via their API and handles order fulfilment and delivery emails. Payment will run through a standard WooCommerce payment gateway.

Your job is to stand the site up, configure it properly, and — most importantly — make the product browsing and purchase experience genuinely good, because the supplier's out-of-the-box presentation is basic.

Scope of work:

Install and configure WordPress + WooCommerce on our hosting
Install and configure the supplier's catalog-import plugin (we'll provide it and its documentation)
Select and set up a suitable theme, using a child theme for all customization
Customize the product page UX — products come in multiple options (e.g. size and duration); we need customers to select one option and then choose a quantity, plus the ability to group/filter options by type
Improve product search — WooCommerce's default search is not good enough for our catalog
Integrate a payment gateway, customer accounts, and transactional emails
Basic responsive/mobile polish and essential SEO hygiene
Handover: documentation and a short walkthrough

Important technical context:

The supplier plugin re-syncs the catalog periodically and overwrites product data. Any customization must survive re-syncs and plugin updates — no editing plugin or theme core files.
We're open to either custom development or an off-the-shelf plugin for the product-page UX. If a ready-made solution does the job well, we'd prefer it — tell us which and why.
We are technically informed: we've reviewed the supplier plugin's behaviour in detail and have a UI mock of the target product page, which we'll share with shortlisted candidates.
What we provide

Hosting, domain, the supplier plugin and credentials, the UI mock, brand assets, and fast decision-making on our side.

Required skills:

Deep, demonstrable WooCommerce experience (not just general WordPress)
Strong grasp of WooCommerce product types and when to use each
Comfortable with PHP, hooks/filters, child themes, and template overrides
Experience integrating third-party/API-driven plugins
Payment gateway setup; clean, responsive front-end work

Your proposal must include (proposals without these will not be reviewed):

Your recommended approach — custom build vs. off-the-shelf plugin, and the reasoning
A realistic timeline with milestones (in days/weeks) — we value realistic over optimistic, but short timelines with a credible plan will win
What you need from us to start and to avoid delays
Pricing — fixed price preferred, with milestones
2–3 links to live WooCommerce sites you've built, ideally with customized product pages

title: WordPress Woocommerce Currency and add-on prices setting.
description:
I run tarotrade.com, a WooCommerce store selling Yamaha Electone sheet music and instruments to international customers. Prices are stored and processed in JPY, and we use WOOCS to display local currencies.

We've added product options (add-on pricing), but the option prices are not passing through the WOOCS exchange rate — only the base product price converts correctly. A previous developer wrote the currency display code, so part of the job will be reviewing and modifying that existing code.

Before we discuss scope, I'd like to ask one technical question:

Without seeing the code yet, which filter hooks would you expect to be involved in this, and how would you approach making the add-on prices pass through the WOOCS conversion?

A short answer is fine — I just want to make sure we're on the same page technically. If it looks like a good fit, I'll set up a staging site and we can start with a small fixed-price job.



Thanks,
Taro
Taro's TRADE JAPAN
www.tartrade.com

title: Meta Instagram API App Review Specialist for WordPress Website
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Developer / Instagram API specialist to review our current integration on a WordPress website and help us obtain approval for the instagram_business_basic permission.

The OAuth flow is already implemented and appears to be working correctly. Users can connect their Instagram professional account, and the WordPress website retrieves the expected account data. However, Meta has rejected the App Review submission several times because the screencast allegedly does not align with the submitted use case.

The selected freelancer should:

- Review the Meta app configuration
- Audit the Instagram integration on our WordPress website
- Check the Instagram Business Login and OAuth flow
- Verify redirect URLs, permissions, access tokens, and callback handling
- Confirm that the requested permission matches the implemented functionality
- Review the screencast and reviewer instructions
- Improve the use-case description
- Identify the likely cause of the repeated rejection
- Help prepare and submit a new App Review request

The integration is already developed. We mainly need an expert to verify that the implementation is correct, confirm that OAuth works as expected, and help us align the submission with Meta’s review requirements.

title: WordPress + WooCommerce Developer — Launch Storefront for API-Imported Digital Products
description:
We're launching an online store selling digital prepaid service plans — virtual products, delivered electronically after purchase, with no physical shipping. We do not have a website yet, so this is a build from zero.

Our supplier provides a WordPress plugin that imports the product catalog via their API and handles order fulfilment and delivery emails. Payment will run through a standard WooCommerce payment gateway.

Your job is to stand the site up, configure it properly, and — most importantly — make the product browsing and purchase experience genuinely good, because the supplier's out-of-the-box presentation is basic.

Scope of work:

Install and configure WordPress + WooCommerce on our hosting
Install and configure the supplier's catalog-import plugin (we'll provide it and its documentation)
Select and set up a suitable theme, using a child theme for all customization
Customize the product page UX — products come in multiple options (e.g. size and duration); we need customers to select one option and then choose a quantity, plus the ability to group/filter options by type
Improve product search — WooCommerce's default search is not good enough for our catalog
Integrate a payment gateway, customer accounts, and transactional emails
Basic responsive/mobile polish and essential SEO hygiene
Handover: documentation and a short walkthrough

Important technical context:

The supplier plugin re-syncs the catalog periodically and overwrites product data. Any customization must survive re-syncs and plugin updates — no editing plugin or theme core files.
We're open to either custom development or an off-the-shelf plugin for the product-page UX. If a ready-made solution does the job well, we'd prefer it — tell us which and why.
We are technically informed: we've reviewed the supplier plugin's behaviour in detail and have a UI mock of the target product page, which we'll share with shortlisted candidates.
What we provide

Hosting, domain, the supplier plugin and credentials, the UI mock, brand assets, and fast decision-making on our side.

Required skills:

Deep, demonstrable WooCommerce experience (not just general WordPress)
Strong grasp of WooCommerce product types and when to use each
Comfortable with PHP, hooks/filters, child themes, and template overrides
Experience integrating third-party/API-driven plugins

title: Php devolper
description:
We are looking for an experienced PHP Developer to join our team for ongoing website development, maintenance, and feature enhancements. The ideal candidate should have strong backend development skills, be able to work independently, and deliver clean, secure, and scalable code.

Responsibilities

Maintain and enhance PHP-based web application.

Build new features and improve existing website functionality.

Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues.

Optimize website performance, speed, and security.

Integrate third-party APIs and payment gateways when required.

Work with MySQL databases, write optimized queries, and manage database structures.

Collaborate with designers and front-end developers to implement responsive and user-friendly interfaces.

Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.
Perform regular website updates and maintenance.

Required Skills

Strong experience with PHP and MySQL
Experience with Laravel, CodeIgniter, or other PHP frameworks (preferred)

Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap

Experience with REST APIs and third-party integrations

Understanding of MVC architecture

Version control using Git

Basic knowledge of web hosting, cPanel, and server management

Experience with WordPress (optional but preferred)

Qualifications

Proven experience as a PHP Developer with a strong portfolio.

Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Good communication skills and the ability to meet project deadlines.

Project Type
Ongoing/Freelance
Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

title: Meta Instagram API App Review Specialist for WordPress Website
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Developer / Instagram API specialist to review our current integration on a WordPress website and help us obtain approval for the instagram_business_basic permission.

The OAuth flow is already implemented and appears to be working correctly. Users can connect their Instagram professional account, and the WordPress website retrieves the expected account data. However, Meta has rejected the App Review submission several times because the screencast allegedly does not align with the submitted use case.

The selected freelancer should:

- Review the Meta app configuration
- Audit the Instagram integration on our WordPress website
- Check the Instagram Business Login and OAuth flow
- Verify redirect URLs, permissions, access tokens, and callback handling
- Confirm that the requested permission matches the implemented functionality
- Review the screencast and reviewer instructions
- Improve the use-case description
- Identify the likely cause of the repeated rejection
- Help prepare and submit a new App Review request

The integration is already developed. We mainly need an expert to verify that the implementation is correct, confirm that OAuth works as expected, and help us align the submission with Meta’s review requirements.

Responsibilities include editing existing and uploading new content, improving layout, and ensuring the site is user-friendly.

title: Expert WordPress Architect for Premium Educational Publishing Platform
description:
I am looking for an experienced WordPress architect—not just a designer—to build a premium, fast, secure, easy-to-manage publishing platform for a long-term educational business. This is not a complex e-commerce project. The focus is authority, trust, performance, and simplicity.

The website will showcase books, articles, courses, memberships, and digital resources, with purchases handled primarily through Gumroad and Stripe rather than a traditional WooCommerce store. The backend must be intuitive enough for a non-technical owner to update books, courses, pages, and content without relying on a developer.

This is the first phase of a long-term relationship. Future projects may include advanced publishing workflows, AI integration, course portals, SEO, performance optimization, automation, landing pages, and continued growth of the platform. I am looking for someone who thinks like a long-term technical partner, not someone who simply builds websites.

Required experience:

WordPress
Elementor or GeneratePress/Kadence/Block Editor (please recommend the best long-term solution)
Gumroad integration
Stripe integration
SEO fundamentals
Mobile optimization
Performance optimization
Security
Easy-to-maintain backend
Core Web Vitals 90+
Git version control
Staging site before launch
Automated backups
Security hardening
Documentation
AI-friendly architecture for future automation
No unnecessary plugins

Deliverables:

Premium homepage
About page
Books page
Courses page
Articles/Blog
Contact page
Newsletter integration
Gumroad purchase buttons
Basic SEO
Fast loading
Documentation
One recorded walkthrough showing me how to manage everything myself

Please include:

Three examples of premium educational or publishing websites you have built.
Why you chose your preferred WordPress stack.
What you would do differently from a typical WordPress website.

This is intended to become a long-term relationship with the right freelancer.

title: Senior WordPress Technical Consultant
description:
Webrecruit is seeking an experienced Senior WordPress Technical Consultant to undertake a comprehensive technical assessment of our existing WordPress estate as the first phase of a wider stabilisation and modernisation programme.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a complex, business-critical WordPress platform that has evolved over many years and requires structured technical assessment before remediation and future hosting modernisation.

The initial engagement is expected to last approximately 2–3 weeks and will focus on discovery, technical assessment, governance and planning. Subject to a successful outcome, there is significant potential for the successful consultant to lead the subsequent implementation phases over the coming months.

At the completion of the initial engagement, the consultant should provide:

1.	Comprehensive Technical Assessment Report
2.	Platform Architecture & Dependency 
3.	Governance & Operational Assessment
4.	Risk Register
5.	Phased Delivery Plan

Future Opportunity
The successful consultant will have the opportunity to continue into later phases of the programme, including:
●	PHP and database upgrades
●	Plugin rationalisation
●	Security hardening
●	Performance optimisation
●	SEO validation
●	HubSpot and analytics remediation
●	Hosting modernisation
●	Platform migration
●	Ongoing technical governance
●	Documentation and knowledge transfer
Our preference is to retain the same consultant throughout the programme to ensure continuity of knowledge and technical ownership.

Essential Skills
We're looking for someone with demonstrable experience in:
●	WordPress platform architecture
●	Legacy WordPress environments
●	WordPress migrations
●	PHP development & version upgrades
●	Elementor
●	WPBakery / Visual Composer
●	Plugin dependency analysis
●	Performance troubleshooting
●	Hosting migrations
●	Environment setup and configuration
●	Backup and disaster recovery
●	MySQL/MariaDB
●	Technical SEO
●	HREFLANG implementation
●	Google Tag Manager
●	Google Analytics 4
●	HubSpot integrations
●	Diagnosing complex WordPress issues
●	Producing clear technical documentation

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating complex technical problems and can confidently assess, document, and modernise legacy WordPress platforms. This role is not about designing websites or developing new pages.
We are looking for someone who takes a structured, evidence-based approach to technical decision-making and can confidently work in the following areas:
●	server configuration & staging environment setup
●	backups & rollback procedures
●	plugin dependencies
●	custom functionality
●	logging
●	SEO preservation
●	analytics
●	integrations
●	governance
●	operational support

Engagement
●	Freelance contract
●	Initial fixed-fee engagement
●	Approximately 2–3 weeks
●	Remote
●	Flexible working hours

There is strong potential for a longer-term engagement to deliver the remediation and modernisation roadmap following completion of the assessment.

title: WordPress Developer (Elementor / Divi) — Ongoing Work for Design Agency
description:
Overview
We're Omis Digital, a web design & branding agency in Dallas. We have a steady pipeline of WordPress work and are looking for a reliable developer who's genuinely strong with Elementor and/or Divi to be our go-to build partner. This is an ongoing hourly relationship, not a one-off — we want someone we can keep busy and grow with.

What you'll be doing
- Building WordPress sites from our finished designs (Figma/Framer) — pixel-accurate, clean, responsive
- New builds directly in WordPress when we don't have a full design
- Ongoing edits & maintenance on existing client sites (updates, tweaks, bug fixes)
- Migrations and rebuilds (e.g., moving clients off Squarespace/Wix onto WordPress)

You're a strong fit if you
- Are fluent in Elementor and/or Divi and know their quirks inside out
- Build clean, fast, responsive sites that match a design closely
- Are comfortable with WordPress fundamentals: plugins, hosting, DNS, basic troubleshooting, performance
- Communicate clearly in English and give honest timelines
- Are reliable and responsive — this matters more to us than being the cheapest

Nice to have
- Light custom CSS/HTML when a builder can't do the job
- Experience with common plugins (forms, SEO, CRM/booking integrations)
- An eye for design so you can catch things that look "off"

Details
- Ongoing hourly contract with steady, recurring work
- Rate: $25–45/hr depending on experience (feel free to propose yours)
- Start with a small first project so we can both feel out the fit

To apply
Share 2–3 examples of WordPress sites you've built in Elementor or Divi (links preferred), tell us which builder you're strongest in, and include the word "bluebird" at the top of your proposal so we know you read this. We're looking for a long-term partner, not a one-off contractor.

title: WordPress Redesign, Local SEO, and Conversion Specialist
description:
Jim Puffer Landscape is looking for an experienced freelancer or small agency to redesign and optimize our existing WordPress website.

We are a well established and very well known landscape design and construction company serving Kaysville, Utah, and surrounding areas. We want a website that matches the quality of our work and expectations of our customers. It must feel high-end, showcases our projects beautifully, ranks well in local search, and converts visitors into qualified consultation requests.

This is more than a visual redesign. We need someone who understands WordPress, local SEO, visual storytelling, website performance, and conversion strategy.

### Scope of Work

* Redesign and improve our existing WordPress website
* Create a professional, modern, high-end appearance
* Turn completed projects into engaging portfolio or case-study pages
* Improve mobile usability and website speed
* Optimize the site for local Google searches
* Create or improve service and location pages
* Improve calls to action, contact forms, and lead generation
* Set up or verify Google Analytics and Google Search Console
* Track phone clicks, forms, and consultation requests
* Protect existing rankings and URLs during the redesign
* Build and test the redesign on a staging site
* Provide basic training for future website updates

### Ideal Experience

We prefer someone with experience in:

* WordPress design and development
* Local SEO
* Landscaping, construction, remodeling, pools, outdoor living, or other home-service businesses
* Conversion-rate optimization
* Google Business Profile optimization
* Website speed and Core Web Vitals
* Image optimization
* SEO-friendly website redesigns and migrations

Experience with Cloudways hosting is helpful but not required.

### Please Include

* Three relevant websites you personally worked on
* A brief explanation of your role on each project
* Examples involving local or home-service businesses
* Any measurable SEO, traffic, lead, or conversion results
* Your initial thoughts about our current website
* How you would make our projects feel more engaging than a standard photo gallery
* How you would protect our existing Google rankings
* Your estimated timeline and pricing
* Whether you perform the work yourself or use subcontractors

 Ongoing SEO and website support may also be available after launch.

The selected freelancer must work on a staging site, communicate clearly, provide transparent deliverables, and ensure that Jim Puffer Landscape owns all website files, accounts, content, and analytics.

Please do not apply if you guarantee first-place Google rankings or use vague SEO packages without clear deliverables.

Website: [www.jimpufferlandscape.com](http://www.jimpufferlandscape.com)

Please begin your proposal with the words “Landscape Website” so we know you read the full posting.

Thank you

title: Senior WordPress Technical Consultant
description:
Webrecruit is seeking an experienced Senior WordPress Technical Consultant to undertake a comprehensive technical assessment of our existing WordPress estate as the first phase of a wider stabilisation and modernisation programme.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a complex, business-critical WordPress platform that has evolved over many years and requires structured technical assessment before remediation and future hosting modernisation.

The initial engagement is expected to last approximately 2–3 weeks and will focus on discovery, technical assessment, governance and planning. Subject to a successful outcome, there is significant potential for the successful consultant to lead the subsequent implementation phases over the coming months.

At the completion of the initial engagement, the consultant should provide:

1.	Comprehensive Technical Assessment Report
2.	Platform Architecture & Dependency 
3.	Governance & Operational Assessment
4.	Risk Register
5.	Phased Delivery Plan

Future Opportunity
The successful consultant will have the opportunity to continue into later phases of the programme, including:
●	PHP and database upgrades
●	Plugin rationalisation
●	Security hardening
●	Performance optimisation
●	SEO validation
●	HubSpot and analytics remediation
●	Hosting modernisation
●	Platform migration
●	Ongoing technical governance
●	Documentation and knowledge transfer
Our preference is to retain the same consultant throughout the programme to ensure continuity of knowledge and technical ownership.

Essential Skills
We're looking for someone with demonstrable experience in:
●	WordPress platform architecture
●	Legacy WordPress environments
●	WordPress migrations
●	PHP development & version upgrades
●	Elementor
●	WPBakery / Visual Composer
●	Plugin dependency analysis
●	Performance troubleshooting
●	Hosting migrations
●	Environment setup and configuration
●	Backup and disaster recovery
●	MySQL/MariaDB
●	Technical SEO
●	HREFLANG implementation
●	Google Tag Manager
●	Google Analytics 4
●	HubSpot integrations
●	Diagnosing complex WordPress issues
●	Producing clear technical documentation

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys investigating complex technical problems and can confidently assess, document, and modernise legacy WordPress platforms. This role is not about designing websites or developing new pages.
We are looking for someone who takes a structured, evidence-based approach to technical decision-making and can confidently work in the following areas:
●	server configuration & staging environment setup
●	backups & rollback procedures
●	plugin dependencies
●	custom functionality
●	logging
●	SEO preservation
●	analytics
●	integrations
●	governance
●	operational support

Engagement
●	Freelance contract
●	Initial fixed-fee engagement
●	Approximately 2–3 weeks
●	Remote
●	Flexible working hours

There is strong potential for a longer-term engagement to deliver the remediation and modernisation roadmap following completion of the assessment.

title: WordPress Redesign, Local SEO, and Conversion Specialist
description:
Jim Puffer Landscape is looking for an experienced freelancer or small agency to redesign and optimize our existing WordPress website.

We are a well established and very well known landscape design and construction company serving Kaysville, Utah, and surrounding areas. We want a website that matches the quality of our work and expectations of our customers. It must feel high-end, showcases our projects beautifully, ranks well in local search, and converts visitors into qualified consultation requests.

This is more than a visual redesign. We need someone who understands WordPress, local SEO, visual storytelling, website performance, and conversion strategy.

### Scope of Work

* Redesign and improve our existing WordPress website
* Create a professional, modern, high-end appearance
* Turn completed projects into engaging portfolio or case-study pages
* Improve mobile usability and website speed
* Optimize the site for local Google searches
* Create or improve service and location pages
* Improve calls to action, contact forms, and lead generation
* Set up or verify Google Analytics and Google Search Console
* Track phone clicks, forms, and consultation requests
* Protect existing rankings and URLs during the redesign
* Build and test the redesign on a staging site
* Provide basic training for future website updates

### Ideal Experience

We prefer someone with experience in:

* WordPress design and development
* Local SEO
* Landscaping, construction, remodeling, pools, outdoor living, or other home-service businesses
* Conversion-rate optimization
* Google Business Profile optimization
* Website speed and Core Web Vitals
* Image optimization
* SEO-friendly website redesigns and migrations

Experience with Cloudways hosting is helpful but not required.

### Please Include

* Three relevant websites you personally worked on
* A brief explanation of your role on each project
* Examples involving local or home-service businesses
* Any measurable SEO, traffic, lead, or conversion results
* Your initial thoughts about our current website
* How you would make our projects feel more engaging than a standard photo gallery
* How you would protect our existing Google rankings
* Your estimated timeline and pricing
* Whether you perform the work yourself or use subcontractors

 Ongoing SEO and website support may also be available after launch.

The selected freelancer must work on a staging site, communicate clearly, provide transparent deliverables, and ensure that Jim Puffer Landscape owns all website files, accounts, content, and analytics.

Please do not apply if you guarantee first-place Google rankings or use vague SEO packages without clear deliverables.

Website: [www.jimpufferlandscape.com](http://www.jimpufferlandscape.com)

Please begin your proposal with the words “Landscape Website” so we know you read the full posting.

Thank you

title: Elementor Developer Needed
description:
I own a residential cleaning company (The Maids in East Bergen County) serving Bergen County, NJ. I have professionally designed, fully coded HTML files ready to go — I need an Elementor developer to recreate them inside a WordPress site on my custom domain.

This is a straightforward build project. The design work and copywriting are 100% complete. Your job is to faithfully reproduce the page in Elementor so the site is easy for me to maintain going forward.

This contract is for 1 page to start. If the quality is good, I have 3 additional pages ready to build and will hire for those immediately after. Total of 28 pages within the next 6-9 months.

What Needs to Be Built:
- 1 Page to start: Main Landing Page — The Maids in East Bergen County (Hackensack-focused)

The HTML file will be provided to you at project start. The page includes:
- Hero section with headline, subheadline, and CTA button
- Services grid (6 cards)
- "Why Us" section (3 cards)
- Customer reviews section (3 cards)
- FAQ accordion
- CTA band
- Footer with links and contact info
- Sticky navigation bar

Technical Requirements:
- WordPress already installed (I will provide login credentials)
- Elementor (Free or Pro — you choose what's needed)
- Match the HTML design pixel-for-pixel: colors, fonts, spacing, layout
- Brand colors: Primary Blue #003B6F, Dark Blue #00274D, Gold #F5B800
- Font: Inter (Google Fonts)
- All pages must be mobile responsive
- FAQ sections must function as accordions (click to expand/collapse)
- CTA buttons link to: https://www.maids.com/344
- Each page needs a clean WordPress slug (I will provide these)
- JSON-LD schema markup from the HTML files must be preserved in each page's head — this is important for SEO

What I Will Provide:

title: WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix
description:
# WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix

## Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce/WordPress developer to diagnose and fix a Stripe checkout issue on our WooCommerce store.

A customer recently attempted to complete a purchase but reported that they were unable to enter their credit card details during checkout.

When testing Stripe in **Test Mode**, we received the following error banner:

“Please make sure your card details have been entered correctly and that your browser supports JavaScript. Developers: Please make sure that you are including jQuery and there are no JavaScript errors on the page.”

We need a developer who can quickly identify the root cause and restore full Stripe checkout functionality.

## Scope of Work

* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript errors affecting the WooCommerce checkout page.
* Ensure jQuery is properly loaded and functioning.
* Check for theme and plugin conflicts that may be interfering with Stripe Elements.
* Repair or update any outdated WooCommerce checkout template overrides.
* Verify that the Stripe payment fields load correctly and customers can enter card details.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Test Mode**.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Live Mode** after fixes are implemented.
* Confirm that successful payments can be processed without errors.
* Provide a brief explanation of the root cause and the fixes applied.

## Required Skills

* Strong experience with **WooCommerce** and **WordPress**.
* Proven experience troubleshooting **Stripe payment gateway** issues.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript/jQuery** debugging.
* Experience resolving **theme/plugin conflicts**.
* Familiarity with WooCommerce template overrides and checkout customization.
* Ability to test payment gateways safely in both test and live environments.

## Deliverables

* Stripe credit card fields working properly on the checkout page.
* All relevant JavaScript errors resolved.
* Any outdated WooCommerce checkout templates repaired or updated.
* Confirmation that Stripe payments work in both Test Mode and Live Mode.
* A short report outlining the issue found and the steps taken to fix it.

## Additional Information

Please include the following in your proposal:

* Your experience fixing WooCommerce Stripe checkout issues.
* Examples of similar payment gateway problems you have resolved.
* Your estimated time to diagnose and complete the fix.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and complete this task efficiently.

Lafayette Academy is a tutoring and test‑prep center with a long‑established WordPress site that needs an experienced, reliable professional to manage, maintain, and improve it. We use a modern WordPress stack with Divi and a large ecosystem of plugins. I’m looking for someone who can confidently handle performance, security, SEO, updates, troubleshooting, and light development—without needing hand‑holding.

Your Responsibilities

Ongoing management of LafayetteAcademy.com

Update WordPress core, themes, and plugins safely

Optimize site speed, caching, and performance

Maintain security and monitoring

Improve SEO structure, metadata, and rankings

Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, layout issues, and backend errors

Suggest improvements proactively

Keep the site stable, fast, and clean

Required Expertise

WordPress (deep experience)

Divi (page builder, theme structure, responsive editing)

WP Rocket (caching, optimization, CDN settings)

Wordfence (security, firewall tuning, malware scanning)

WP Engine (hosting environment, staging, backups)

Rank Math SEO (schema, metadata, sitemaps, analytics)

Imagify (image compression, WebP, optimization workflows)

And general plugin ecosystem management (we use many)

Ability to streamline plugin load

Experience improving Core Web Vitals

Light PHP / CSS / JS for small fixes

Understanding of educational service websites

What I’m Looking For

Someone who works independently

Communicates clearly and simply

Doesn’t create complexity

Can take ownership of the site’s health

Long-term relationship preferred

To Apply  
Please send:

A short intro

Examples of WordPress sites you manage

Confirmation that you’ve worked with Divi + the plugins listed

Your hourly rate or monthly maintenance rate

title: Elementor Developer Needed
description:
I own a residential cleaning company (The Maids in East Bergen County) serving Bergen County, NJ. I have professionally designed, fully coded HTML files ready to go — I need an Elementor developer to recreate them inside a WordPress site on my custom domain.

This is a straightforward build project. The design work and copywriting are 100% complete. Your job is to faithfully reproduce the page in Elementor so the site is easy for me to maintain going forward.

This contract is for 1 page to start. If the quality is good, I have 3 additional pages ready to build and will hire for those immediately after. Total of 28 pages within the next 6-9 months.

What Needs to Be Built:
- 1 Page to start: Main Landing Page — The Maids in East Bergen County (Hackensack-focused)

The HTML file will be provided to you at project start. The page includes:
- Hero section with headline, subheadline, and CTA button
- Services grid (6 cards)
- "Why Us" section (3 cards)
- Customer reviews section (3 cards)
- FAQ accordion
- CTA band
- Footer with links and contact info
- Sticky navigation bar

Technical Requirements:
- WordPress already installed (I will provide login credentials)
- Elementor (Free or Pro — you choose what's needed)

- All pages must be mobile responsive
- FAQ sections must function as accordions (click to expand/collapse)

What I Will Provide:
- HTML file for the main landing page (complete, ready to reference)
- WordPress login credentials
- Domain/hosting already set up
- Brand color codes and font name
- Page slug and CTA URL
- This job description as a reference

What I'm Looking For:
- Experience building local service business websites in Elementor
- Strong attention to detail — the HTML files are the spec, please match them closely
- Ability to preserve custom head code (schema markup) per page
- Clear communication and a short turnaround (ideally within 2–5 business days)
- Portfolio showing similar Elementor builds preferred

Budget & Timeline:
- Estimated budget: $50–$100 for the first page (open to quotes)
- Timeline: 2–3 business days from project start
Fixed-price contract preferred
- If the work is great, 3 additional pages will follow immediately, with the potential for 28 total over the next 6-9 months

How to Apply:
- Please include in your proposal:
- Links to 2–3 Elementor sites you've built (local service businesses preferred)
- Confirm you can preserve custom JSON-LD schema in the head of each page
- Your estimated timeline and fixed-price quote
- Any questions about the project

Looking forward to working with someone detail-oriented who can get this done cleanly and quickly!

title: WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix
description:
# WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix

## Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce/WordPress developer to diagnose and fix a Stripe checkout issue on our WooCommerce store.

A customer recently attempted to complete a purchase but reported that they were unable to enter their credit card details during checkout.

When testing Stripe in **Test Mode**, we received the following error banner:

“Please make sure your card details have been entered correctly and that your browser supports JavaScript. Developers: Please make sure that you are including jQuery and there are no JavaScript errors on the page.”

We need a developer who can quickly identify the root cause and restore full Stripe checkout functionality.

## Scope of Work

* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript errors affecting the WooCommerce checkout page.
* Ensure jQuery is properly loaded and functioning.
* Check for theme and plugin conflicts that may be interfering with Stripe Elements.
* Repair or update any outdated WooCommerce checkout template overrides.
* Verify that the Stripe payment fields load correctly and customers can enter card details.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Test Mode**.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Live Mode** after fixes are implemented.
* Confirm that successful payments can be processed without errors.
* Provide a brief explanation of the root cause and the fixes applied.

## Required Skills

* Strong experience with **WooCommerce** and **WordPress**.
* Proven experience troubleshooting **Stripe payment gateway** issues.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript/jQuery** debugging.
* Experience resolving **theme/plugin conflicts**.
* Familiarity with WooCommerce template overrides and checkout customization.
* Ability to test payment gateways safely in both test and live environments.

## Deliverables

* Stripe credit card fields working properly on the checkout page.
* All relevant JavaScript errors resolved.
* Any outdated WooCommerce checkout templates repaired or updated.
* Confirmation that Stripe payments work in both Test Mode and Live Mode.
* A short report outlining the issue found and the steps taken to fix it.

## Additional Information

Please include the following in your proposal:

* Your experience fixing WooCommerce Stripe checkout issues.
* Examples of similar payment gateway problems you have resolved.
* Your estimated time to diagnose and complete the fix.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and complete this task efficiently.

title: LVC Website Development
description:
Project Overview

The Contractor will provide WordPress and Elementor Pro development services for the Longview Commercial website. All work will be completed within the Longview Commercial staging environment.

The project is divided into two phases.

⸻

Phase 1 – Existing Page Migration

Scope

Transfer the existing HTML-based website pages into fully editable Elementor Pro pages while preserving the existing design, layout and functionality.

The pages included are:

1. Home
2. Strategy
3. Portfolio
4. Governance
5. Leadership
6. Investor Experience
7. Insights
8. FAQs
9. Market Intelligence
10. Investor Perspectives
11. Longview 60
12. Schedule a Call
13. Contact Us
14. Request Investor Access
15. Subscribe to Newsletter
16. Legal Disclosure
17. Terms of Use
18. Privacy Policy
19. Cookie Policy
20. International Policy

Deliverables

* Convert all listed pages into Elementor Pro.
* Maintain responsive desktop and mobile layouts.
* Ensure pages remain fully editable within Elementor.
* Preserve existing styling and branding.
* Complete all work within the Longview Commercial staging environment.

⸻

Phase 2 – Dynamic Content System

Scope

Design and build the dynamic content structure for the website.

Deliverables

Market Intelligence Reports

Create:

* One dynamic Summary Report template
* One dynamic Full Report template

Requirements include:

* Dynamic population of report content
* Unique Summary URL for each city
* Unique Full Report URL for each city
* Integration point for embedded Cashflow Portal HTML form on the Summary page
* Architecture that supports approximately 25+ market reports with future expansion

Content Management System

Create four custom content types:

* Market Intelligence Reports
* Investor Perspectives (Articles)
* Longview 60 (Video Reels)
* Education

The CMS should be designed to allow easy creation, editing and publishing of future content through the WordPress admin.

⸻

Hours & Compensation

* Hourly Rate: $20.00/hour
* Total Authorized Budget: 30 hours

Initial Evaluation Period

The engagement will begin with an initial allocation of 10 hours starting with the homepage including header, navigation and footer and then additional pages.

The purpose of Phase 1 is to allow both parties to evaluate communication, quality of work, efficiency and overall fit before proceeding with the remaining project.

Upon satisfactory completion of the initial 10-hour engagement, the Client intends to continue the project for the remaining authorized hours, subject to mutual agreement.

⸻

Schedule

* Start Date: July 24, 2026
* Total timeframe target: 3–5 calendar days

⸻

Communication

* Communication will take place through Zoom.
* Screen-sharing sessions may be scheduled as needed to review requirements and completed work.
* Questions or clarification requests should be raised promptly to avoid delays.

⸻

Acceptance

Work will be considered complete when the agreed deliverables have been implemented in the staging environment and reviewed by the Client.

Any requested revisions that fall within the agreed scope will be completed before final acceptance.

title: Senior Developer (Full Stack) MUST BE IN AUSTRALIA NEWZEALAND OR SE ASIA
description:
Senior Developer (Full Stack) WordPress Experience mandatory

Good to Great Schools Australia Limited 
 
About the Organisation 
 
Good to Great Schools Australia (GGSA) partners with schools and school systems to support school improvement along a journey from Poor to Fair, Fair to Good and Good to Great. 

GGSA is modern and innovative, and we are well set up to support roles from being carried out at home. 

About the Role 
 
We are looking for a Senior Developer who can create engaging and interactive online learning experiences using PHP, WordPress and Learn Dash. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our website, customising themes and plugins, and integrating various e-learning features and functionalities. You will lead the team and review code before development goes through production. 

As part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, you will design and deliver cutting-edge web applications that underpin our school and teacher support programmes. This role demands a developer with expertise across front-end and back-end technologies, particularly within cloud-based environments, who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic setting. 

Key Responsibilities 

Strong knowledge of PHP, especially in WordPress development and debugging (PHP 8.1+).
Experience with headless CMS architecture, specifically with NextJS.
Experience with WordPress themes and plugins, including Learndash, WooCommerce, Divi, etc.
Familiarity with front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and experience with TypeScript, React/NextJs, SCSS.
Familiarity with web development tooling, including phpcs, phpmd, phpstan, phpunit, codecept, Docker BuildKit, TS config, eslint, prettier, postcss, tailwind, and advanced webpack configuration.
Experience with containerisation using Docker/compose, including managing dependencies with composer and npm/yarn/pnpm.
Experience with GraphQL APIs, particularly using Hasura.
Knowledge of database management systems, particularly MySQL/MariaDB (10+)
Understanding of Git workflow and familiarity with CLI/terminal commands.
Ability to create responsive and adaptive web designs that work across different devices and browsers
Understanding of web development best practices, such as SEO, accessibility, performance, security, etc.
Good communication and collaboration skills, as well as the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
Experience leading a development team, providing guidance and ensuring code quality.
A portfolio of previous web development projects that demonstrate your skills and creativity.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentor junior developers, and participate in code reviews. 
Work independently while maintaining a strong, continuous flow of communication within a remote-first team. 

Desirable Skills 

Experience with other e-learning platforms or tools, such as Moodle, SCORM, LMS, etc.
Knowledge of web design principles and tools, such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, etc.
Familiarity with web development frameworks or libraries, such as Laravel, React, Vue, etc.
Background in education technology or experience in an Agile development environment. 
Knowledge of DevOps practices and experience with CI/CD pipelines. 

Benefits 

Fully remote position, offering flexibility and a balanced work-life structure. 
Opportunity to lead a greenfield project and work with modern technologies. 
A collaborative and supportive team, contributing to meaningful work in the education sector. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

How to Apply 
 
Applicants need to submit a resume and an application letter that addresses the essential selection criteria above. GGSA does NOT consider applications who do not address the selection criteria. 

If you are looking for the next stage of your career and have a desire to contribute to a not-for-profit organisation that supports Australian schools, we'd love to hear from you!

**All applications will be reviewed for authenticity, and responses may be checked using AI-detection tools as part of our screening process.**

title: WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix
description:
# WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix

## Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce/WordPress developer to diagnose and fix a Stripe checkout issue on our WooCommerce store.

A customer recently attempted to complete a purchase but reported that they were unable to enter their credit card details during checkout.

When testing Stripe in **Test Mode**, we received the following error banner:

“Please make sure your card details have been entered correctly and that your browser supports JavaScript. Developers: Please make sure that you are including jQuery and there are no JavaScript errors on the page.”

We need a developer who can quickly identify the root cause and restore full Stripe checkout functionality.

## Scope of Work

* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript errors affecting the WooCommerce checkout page.
* Ensure jQuery is properly loaded and functioning.
* Check for theme and plugin conflicts that may be interfering with Stripe Elements.
* Repair or update any outdated WooCommerce checkout template overrides.
* Verify that the Stripe payment fields load correctly and customers can enter card details.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Test Mode**.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Live Mode** after fixes are implemented.
* Confirm that successful payments can be processed without errors.
* Provide a brief explanation of the root cause and the fixes applied.

## Required Skills

* Strong experience with **WooCommerce** and **WordPress**.
* Proven experience troubleshooting **Stripe payment gateway** issues.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript/jQuery** debugging.
* Experience resolving **theme/plugin conflicts**.
* Familiarity with WooCommerce template overrides and checkout customization.
* Ability to test payment gateways safely in both test and live environments.

## Deliverables

* Stripe credit card fields working properly on the checkout page.
* All relevant JavaScript errors resolved.
* Any outdated WooCommerce checkout templates repaired or updated.
* Confirmation that Stripe payments work in both Test Mode and Live Mode.
* A short report outlining the issue found and the steps taken to fix it.

## Additional Information

Please include the following in your proposal:

* Your experience fixing WooCommerce Stripe checkout issues.
* Examples of similar payment gateway problems you have resolved.
* Your estimated time to diagnose and complete the fix.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and complete this task efficiently.

Good to Great Schools Australia Limited 
 
About the Organisation 
 
Good to Great Schools Australia (GGSA) partners with schools and school systems to support school improvement along a journey from Poor to Fair, Fair to Good and Good to Great. 

GGSA is modern and innovative, and we are well set up to support roles from being carried out at home. 

About the Role 
 
We are looking for a Senior Developer who can create engaging and interactive online learning experiences using PHP, WordPress and Learn Dash. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining our website, customising themes and plugins, and integrating various e-learning features and functionalities. You will lead the team and review code before development goes through production. 

As part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, you will design and deliver cutting-edge web applications that underpin our school and teacher support programmes. Strong knowledge of PHP, especially in WordPress development and debugging (PHP 8.1+).
Experience with headless CMS architecture, specifically with NextJS.
Experience with WordPress themes and plugins, including Learndash, WooCommerce, Divi, etc.
Familiarity with front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, and experience with TypeScript, React/NextJs, SCSS.
Familiarity with web development tooling, including phpcs, phpmd, phpstan, phpunit, codecept, Docker BuildKit, TS config, eslint, prettier, postcss, tailwind, and advanced webpack configuration.
Experience with containerisation using Docker/compose, including managing dependencies with composer and npm/yarn/pnpm.
Experience with GraphQL APIs, particularly using Hasura.
Knowledge of database management systems, particularly MySQL/MariaDB (10+)
Understanding of Git workflow and familiarity with CLI/terminal commands.
Ability to create responsive and adaptive web designs that work across different devices and browsers
Understanding of web development best practices, such as SEO, accessibility, performance, security, etc.
Good communication and collaboration skills, as well as the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
Experience leading a development team, providing guidance and ensuring code quality.
A portfolio of previous web development projects that demonstrate your skills and creativity.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentor junior developers, and participate in code reviews. 
Work independently while maintaining a strong, continuous flow of communication within a remote-first team. 

Desirable Skills 

Experience with other e-learning platforms or tools, such as Moodle, SCORM, LMS, etc.
Knowledge of web design principles and tools, such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, etc.
Familiarity with web development frameworks or libraries, such as Laravel, React, Vue, etc.
Background in education technology or experience in an Agile development environment. 
Knowledge of DevOps practices and experience with CI/CD pipelines. 

Benefits 

Fully remote position, offering flexibility and a balanced work-life structure. 
Opportunity to lead a greenfield project and work with modern technologies. 
A collaborative and supportive team, contributing to meaningful work in the education sector. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 

How to Apply 
 
Applicants need to submit a resume and an application letter that addresses the essential selection criteria above. GGSA does NOT consider applications who do not address the selection criteria. 

If you are looking for the next stage of your career and have a desire to contribute to a not-for-profit organisation that supports Australian schools, we'd love to hear from you!

**All applications will be reviewed for authenticity, and responses may be checked using AI-detection tools as part of our screening process.**

title: WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix
description:
# WooCommerce Stripe Checkout Issue – JavaScript Error Fix

## Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce/WordPress developer to diagnose and fix a Stripe checkout issue on our WooCommerce store.

A customer recently attempted to complete a purchase but reported that they were unable to enter their credit card details during checkout.

When testing Stripe in **Test Mode**, we received the following error banner:

“Please make sure your card details have been entered correctly and that your browser supports JavaScript. Developers: Please make sure that you are including jQuery and there are no JavaScript errors on the page.”

We need a developer who can quickly identify the root cause and restore full Stripe checkout functionality.

## Scope of Work

* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript errors affecting the WooCommerce checkout page.
* Ensure jQuery is properly loaded and functioning.
* Check for theme and plugin conflicts that may be interfering with Stripe Elements.
* Repair or update any outdated WooCommerce checkout template overrides.
* Verify that the Stripe payment fields load correctly and customers can enter card details.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Test Mode**.
* Test Stripe checkout thoroughly in **Live Mode** after fixes are implemented.
* Confirm that successful payments can be processed without errors.
* Provide a brief explanation of the root cause and the fixes applied.

## Required Skills

* Strong experience with **WooCommerce** and **WordPress**.
* Proven experience troubleshooting **Stripe payment gateway** issues.
* Solid understanding of **JavaScript/jQuery** debugging.
* Experience resolving **theme/plugin conflicts**.
* Familiarity with WooCommerce template overrides and checkout customization.
* Ability to test payment gateways safely in both test and live environments.

## Deliverables

* Stripe credit card fields working properly on the checkout page.
* All relevant JavaScript errors resolved.
* Any outdated WooCommerce checkout templates repaired or updated.
* Confirmation that Stripe payments work in both Test Mode and Live Mode.
* A short report outlining the issue found and the steps taken to fix it.

## Additional Information

Please include the following in your proposal:

* Your experience fixing WooCommerce Stripe checkout issues.
* Examples of similar payment gateway problems you have resolved.
* Your estimated time to diagnose and complete the fix.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and complete this task efficiently.

title: Fix Elementor Editor Conflict on WordPress Site — Quick, Scoped Fix
description:

Not a redesign or rebuild.

The site:

WordPress + Elementor (free version), hosted on Bluehost
Built on the Crocoblock/Jet ecosystem (JetThemeCore, JetElements, JetMenu, JetTabs, JetBlocks, JetBlog, JetTricks) with the Kava/Addendum theme

The Elementor editor panel intermittently loads greyed-out with a stuck loading spinner, and becomes fully unresponsive

The remaining issue is: something is conflicting with Elementor itself and needs to be isolated

What I need:

Diagnose which plugin (or plugin combination) is conflicting with Elementor, ideally by testing on a staging copy of the site rather than the live site
Resolve the conflict (this may mean an update, a compatible replacement, or a configuration fix — your judgment as the expert)
Confirm the live site remains fully stable and unchanged in appearance/functionality afterward
Brief written summary of what was causing it and what you did, in plain English, so I can keep this on file for the client

What I don't need:

No content, copy, or image changes — I'm handling all of that myself
No design changes, no theme replacement, no site rebuild
No changes beyond what's needed to fix this specific conflict

Ideal freelancer:

Strong hands-on experience with Elementor troubleshooting specifically
Familiarity with Crocoblock/JetPlugins or similar page-builder ecosystems is a big plus
Comfortable working safely on a live client site (staging environment preferred, backup taken before any changes)
Can communicate findings clearly to a non-developer

Please include in your proposal: your experience with Elementor + Crocoblock/Jet plugins specifically, and your general approach to safely testing this kind of conflict without risking downtime.

title: Digital Project Coordinator – WordPress to App Migration (Contract, Project-Based)

This is a contract, project-based engagement estimated at 3+ months, with the possibility of extension depending on project scope.

You'll work directly with our Director of Digital and internal team, taking ownership of the migration from start to finish - not just executing tasks, but tracking progress, flagging risks, and keeping the whole project on schedule.

What you'll be doing:
Content & Page Migration: Move articles, posts, and media from legacy WordPress sites into our new CMS backend, rebuilding and formatting pages for clean, on-brand presentation.

Graphic & Asset Optimization: Resize, crop, and reformat images and promotional assets to exact web and mobile specs using tools like Photoshop, Canva, or Figma

Mobile App QA & Store Prep: Run end-to-end testing on our mobile app, capture required screenshots, and compile assets for App Store and Google Play submission.

Quality Assurance: Audit migrated pages and apps for broken links, formatting issues, and brand consistency.

Analytics & SEO Continuity: Verify GA4 tracking and update Google Search Console properties (sitemaps, indexing, property verification) so nothing breaks in the switch.

Project Tracking: Own your own timeline against the migration schedule, proactively flag blockers, and keep things moving without needing to be chased.

Vendor Coordination: Work with our vendors and internal team to troubleshoot issues through launch.

title: Custom WordPress Build for Magazine
description:
The project

I'm building a German-language magazine on longevity, fitness, nutrition and sleep — evidence-based, editorial in tone, aimed at an educated and sceptical audience.

The defining feature is a transparent evidence rating: every article, glossary term and recommendation carries a visible rating of how solid the underlying science actually is. It is what separates the site from the usual supplement marketing, and building that component well is the heart of this job.

This is a private long-term project, not agency work. It's already carefully thought through — I've written the brief, the content model and the mockups myself, and I have roughly 360 finished glossary entries waiting to be imported.

The interesting part

The evidence rating is not a badge you drop in a template. It is:

Five states — three of them points on an evidence scale (solid / promising / hype), two of them orthogonal categories that deliberately render differently.
Three rendering variants from a single source value: a compact inline chip (automatic, appears wherever an item is listed), a header badge (automatic, one per article), and a detailed in-body callout (placed manually by me, mid-article).
Taxonomy-driven, not post meta — so listings and category hubs can filter by it cheaply.
A Gutenberg block with server-side render, plus an equivalent shortcode fallback. Both are needed: I draft articles as Markdown outside WordPress and paste them in, and blocks don't survive a paste.
Built for volume. A supplement round-up routinely contains 15–20 callouts in one article, all referencing a single shared source-numbering namespace, with the anchor IDs owned by the sources block rather than the callouts. That constraint is where most implementations would break, and §4.2.2 of the brief spells it out.

If that reads as a fun problem rather than a headache, we'll probably get along.

Scope

I'd like to commission this in two phases, and I'd like the quote split accordingly.

Phase 1 — the magazine. Remove the existing demo content, build a custom editorial layout, article and category templates, seven categories with hub pages, menus, core pages, the complete evidence rating component, the German legal layer (cookie consent, Consent Mode v2 via GTM, self-hosted fonts, template-enforced disclaimers), and the performance baseline. Success criterion: I can publish articles properly.

Phase 2 — the two content systems.

Glossary: custom post type for 500+ terms, one indexable page per term, DefinedTerm / DefinedTermSet schema, thematic cluster hubs, A–Z index, lightweight instant filtering, and a re-runnable, idempotent CSV importer (I supply the content; matching on slug so corrections don't create duplicates).
Recommendations: custom post type for a curated affiliate section, with a per-entry toggle that drives rel="sponsored nofollow" and the advertising label automatically — because the site launches with plain links and I swap them for affiliate URLs later, once the networks approve me.

Plus handover documentation.

Explicit non-goals
No page builder. No Elementor, Divi, WPBakery. The article body is Gutenberg; a builder would mean maintaining the evidence component twice for no benefit.
No demo or starter-site import. The current GeneratePress "Journal" demo is being discarded, and I don't want a different one in its place.
No WooCommerce. The recommendations section links out to third parties — it is an editorial link collection, not a shop. No cart, no checkout, no payment.
No content writing. I write everything: articles, glossary, page copy.
No logo design. Already finalised.
Environment

Shared Apache hosting (ALL-INKL Premium), PHP 8.5, Zend OPcache only — no Redis, no server-side page cache, no CDN. Core Web Vitals still matter to me, so caching strategy and image delivery need actual thought rather than a default plugin install. The tariff includes real cron jobs, SSH and full .htaccess access, all currently unused. §11 of the brief covers this in detail.

All custom functionality must live in a site-specific plugin, not the theme, so it survives a theme change.

One requirement I care about more than usual

After handover I must be able to maintain the site myself. Adding glossary terms, correcting entries, swapping affiliate URLs — all of it without hiring a developer each time.

Concretely: labelled German fields with helper text, list views with sortable columns and filters, bulk edit, and a short written guide. A system only its author can operate is not a finished system, and §8.5 and §9.2 of the brief make this an acceptance criterion rather than a preference.

What you get
A brief that has already answered the awkward questions — data model, naming, edge cases, failure modes, accessibility, schema, legal. You should have to guess very little.
HTML mockups as visual reference. They're direction, not a pixel contract; sensible UX improvements are welcome.
No deadline. Genuinely none. This is a personal project — you can fit it around urgent paid work, and I'd rather have it done well over several weeks than rushed.
Follow-up work if the collaboration goes well. I have further projects planned, including a searchable studio map and a premium listing service.
What I'm looking for in you
Comfortable writing custom WordPress code — custom post types, taxonomies, a Gutenberg block with block.json and server-side render, template hierarchy, a CSV importer.
Understands structured data and why DefinedTerm and additionalProperty are the right choices here.
Takes accessibility seriously — WCAG AA is a requirement in this brief, not a wish.
Willing to push back where you disagree with the spec. The brief marks a dozen decisions as yours; I'd rather hear an argument than get silent compliance.
How to apply

Two things, and please skip the generic pitch:

One specific question about the brief. Anything — a decision you'd make differently, an edge case you think I've missed, a constraint you'd challenge. It tells me far more than a portfolio does.
A quote split by phase (Phase 1 / Phase 2), plus a rough timeline for Phase 1.

If you'd also answer the questions in §16, that's ideal — but the one question above matters most.

title: Senior Developer (Full Stack) MUST BE IN AUSTRALIA NEWZEALAND OR SE ASIA

Strong knowledge of PHP, especially in WordPress development and debugging (PHP 8.1+).

Experience with GraphQL APIs, particularly using Hasura.
Knowledge of database management systems, particularly MySQL/MariaDB (10+)
Understanding of Git workflow and familiarity with CLI/terminal commands.
Ability to create responsive and adaptive web designs that work across different devices and browsers
Understanding of web development best practices, such as SEO, accessibility, performance, security, etc.
Good communication and collaboration skills, as well as the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
Experience leading a development team, providing guidance and ensuring code quality.
A portfolio of previous web development projects that demonstrate your skills and creativity.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentor junior developers, and participate in code reviews. 
Work independently while maintaining a strong, continuous flow of communication within a remote-first team. 

Desirable Skills 

Experience with other e-learning platforms or tools, such as Moodle, SCORM, LMS, etc.
Knowledge of web design principles and tools, such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, etc.
Familiarity with web development frameworks or libraries, such as Laravel, React, Vue, etc.
Background in education technology or experience in an Agile development environment. 
Knowledge of DevOps practices and experience with CI/CD pipelines. 

Benefits 

Fully remote position, offering flexibility and a balanced work-life structure. 
Opportunity to lead a greenfield project and work with modern technologies. 
A collaborative and supportive team, contributing to meaningful work in the education sector. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
